```tsx
import { AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX, type RestoreGap, type RestoreView, type StaffOverview } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ApiError, createStaffApi } from "../src/api";
import { checkDownload, downloadCopy, parseKeyFilter } from "../src/audit-log";
import { MODERATION_MESSAGES, RECOVERY_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { AuthoritiesLines } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { RestoreScreen, type RestoreScreenProps } from "../src/screens/Restore";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { fakeFetch } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * 3f Task 6 (design, sections 7.16, 8.2, 8.7 and 8.8): the console's side of recovery. The download's lines are held to
 * run from the place after the last copy to the head without a break before anything is saved, and the mark is posted
 * only after the file is saved; nothing newer asks for no key. After a restore lists the gaps by class in the order to
 * take them again, with the controls of 8.8 and nothing of a lost row. Home says how old the copy is and how many gaps
 * are open. Every sentence is the messages' own.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) => out.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").replaceAll("&quot;", '"').replaceAll("&#x27;", "'").replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const NOW = Date.parse("2026-10-10T12:00:00.000Z");
const AT = "2026-10-08T09:00:00.000Z";
const ID = "1b2c3d4e-5f60-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d";
const CASE = "2c3d4e5f-6071-4b8c-9daf-1f2a3b4c5d6e";
const ORDER = "3d4e5f60-7182-4c9d-8ebf-2a3b4c5d6e7f";

const hashOf = (place: number) => place.toString(16).padStart(64, "0");
/** A line of the download at a place, naming the place before it. */
const line = (place: number, prev = hashOf(place - 1)) =>
  JSON.stringify({
    v: 1,
    place,
    id: place,
    at: AT,
    actor: ID,
    action: "probe",
    targetType: null,
    targetId: null,
    requestId: null,
    staffSession: null,
    keyId: null,
    actionHash: null,
    stepUp: null,
    metadata: "{}",
    prevHash: prev,
    hash: hashOf(place),
  });
const body = (from: number, to: number) => Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => line(from + i)).join(LF) + LF;

describe("the download's check (7.16 step 4)", () => {
  test("lines that run from the place after the last copy to the head, each naming the one before, are held", () => {
    expect(checkDownload(body(5, 9), 4, 9)?.map((l) => l.place)).toEqual([5, 6, 7, 8, 9]);
  });

  test("a body cut short, a line missing, a line that names another, a line out of place or one that does not parse holds nothing", () => {
    expect(checkDownload(body(5, 7), 4, 9)).toBeNull();
    expect(checkDownload([line(5), line(7)].join(LF), 4, 7)).toBeNull();
    expect(checkDownload([line(5), line(6, "f".repeat(64))].join(LF), 4, 6)).toBeNull();
    expect(checkDownload(body(6, 9), 4, 9)).toBeNull();
    expect(checkDownload(`${line(5)}${LF}{"place": 6`, 4, 6)).toBeNull();
    expect(checkDownload("", 4, 5)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('"Download since my last copy" (7.16, 8.7)', () => {
  /** The download's three steps, recorded: what was asked, what was saved, what was marked. */
  function world(answer: (params: { after: number; through: number }) => Promise<string>, mark: () => Promise<void> = async () => undefined) {
    const steps: string[] = [];
    return {
      steps,
      deps: {
        exportAudit: async (params: { after: number; through: number }) => {
          steps.push(`export ${params.after} ${params.through}`);
          return answer(params);
        },
        markCopy: async (b: { through: number; hash: string }) => {
          steps.push(`mark ${b.through} ${b.hash.slice(-2)}`);
          await mark();
        },
        save: (name: string) => steps.push(`save ${name}`),
      },
    };
  }

  test("from the last copy to the head: the key's download, the file saved, then the mark with the last line's place and hash", async () => {
    const w = world(async ({ after, through }) => body(after + 1, through));
    expect(await downloadCopy(w.deps, 40, 45)).toEqual({ kind: "done", from: 41, to: 45, rows: 5 });
    expect(w.steps).toEqual(["export 40 45", "save korbat-audit-41-45.jsonl", "mark 45 2d"]);
    // Before the first copy it starts after place 0, and a long log is taken AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX rows at a time.
    const first = world(async ({ after, through }) => body(after + 1, through));
    expect(await downloadCopy(first.deps, null, AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX + 7)).toEqual({ kind: "done", from: 1, to: AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX, rows: AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX });
  });

  test("nothing newer asks for no key; a body that broke off saves and marks nothing; a mark the database refused records nothing", async () => {
    const none = world(async () => "");
    expect(await downloadCopy(none.deps, 45, 45)).toEqual({ kind: "none", lastPlace: 45 });
    expect(none.steps).toEqual([]);
    const cut = world(async ({ after }) => body(after + 1, after + 2));
    expect(await downloadCopy(cut.deps, 40, 45)).toEqual({ kind: "broken" });
    expect(cut.steps).toEqual(["export 40 45"]);
    const dropped = world(async () => {
      throw new ApiError(0, "network");
    });
    expect(await downloadCopy(dropped.deps, 40, 45)).toEqual({ kind: "broken" });
    const refused = world(
      async ({ after, through }) => body(after + 1, through),
      async () => {
        throw new ApiError(409, "copy_mismatch");
      },
    );
    expect(await downloadCopy(refused.deps, 40, 45)).toEqual({ kind: "broken" });
    // Every other refusal (the key, a session that ended) is the screen's to word.
    const keyless = world(async () => {
      throw new ApiError(403, "staff_step_up_required");
    });
    await expect(downloadCopy(keyless.deps, 40, 45)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "staff_step_up_required" });
    expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.copy_mismatch).toBe(RECOVERY_WORDS.broken);
  });

  test("the key filter: a key's id as staff.js keys prints it, and each end an instant or empty", () => {
    expect(parseKeyFilter(` ${ID.toUpperCase()} `, "", "")).toEqual({ key: ID });
    expect(parseKeyFilter(ID, "2026-10-10T01:00:00Z", "")).toEqual({ key: ID, from: "2026-10-10T01:00:00Z" });
    expect(parseKeyFilter("not a key", "", "")).toBeNull();
    expect(parseKeyFilter(ID, "yesterday", "")).toBeNull();
    expect(parseKeyFilter(ID, "2026-10-10T02:00:00Z", "2026-10-10T01:00:00Z")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the API client: a decision that takes a lost one again names its gap; the key filter goes in the query", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      [`POST /api/staff/cases/${CASE}/decisions?gap=${ID}`]: { status: 409, body: { error: { code: "gap_mismatch", message: "x", requestId: "r" } } },
      [`GET /api/staff/audit?key=${ID}&from=2026-10-10T01%3A00%3A00Z`]: { status: 200, body: { entries: [], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: 3 } } },
    });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    await expect(api.decide(CASE, {} as never, {}, ID)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "gap_mismatch" });
    await expect(api.decide(CASE, {} as never, {}, "NOT-A-GAP")).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_request" });
    expect((await api.audit({ key: ID, from: "2026-10-10T01:00:00Z" })).copy).toEqual({ lastPlace: 3 });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/cli-restore.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { decisionClass, parseRestoreArgs, readTail, walkTail } from "../src/cli/restore";
import { parseStaffArgs } from "../src/cli/staff";
import { CHAIN_ZERO_HASH, canonicalText, chainHash } from "../src/staff";

/**
 * restore-import's reading of the keeper's files, without a database (3f design, sections 7.17 step 2.1 and 8.11): each
 * line's hash recomputes from its own members with the chain's canonical text; the lines at or below the restored head
 * are checked, the run above it must continue the head, a changed line refuses everything and a hole ends the run. And
 * the class a lost decision's gap gets (6.6).
 */
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const AT = "2026-10-10T01:00:00.123Z";

/** A chain of lines from place 1, each hashed as the trigger hashes a row, as AuditExportLine JSON. */
function chain(n: number, action = "probe"): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let prev = CHAIN_ZERO_HASH;
  for (let place = 1; place <= n; place++) {
    const row = {
      chainVersion: 1,
      chainSeq: place,
      id: place,
      createdAt: new Date(AT),
      actorId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      action,
      targetType: null,
      targetId: null,
      requestId: null,
      staffSession: null,
      keyId: null,
      actionHash: null,
      stepUpText: null,
      metadataText: `{"n": ${place}}`,
    };
    const hash = chainHash(prev, canonicalText(row));
    lines.push(
      JSON.stringify({
        v: 1,
        place,
        id: place,
        at: AT,
        actor: row.actorId,
        action: row.action,
        targetType: null,
        targetId: null,
        requestId: null,
        staffSession: null,
        keyId: null,
        actionHash: null,
        stepUp: null,
        metadata: row.metadataText,
        prevHash: prev,
        hash,
      }),
    );
    prev = hash;
  }
  return lines;
}
const input = (lines: readonly string[]) => Buffer.from(lines.join(LF) + LF, "utf8");
const hashAt = (lines: readonly string[], place: number) => (JSON.parse(lines[place - 1]!) as { hash: string }).hash;
const refusal = /^restore-import: refused: line [0-9]+ does not continue the restored head /;

describe("restore-import's walk of the keeper's files", () => {
  const all = chain(12);
  const head = { seq: 8, hash: hashAt(all, 8) };

  test("files that start before the head: the earlier lines checked, the run from the head's next place imported", () => {
    const walked = walkTail(readTail(input(all.slice(2)), head), head, [{ seq: 5, hash: hashAt(all, 5) }]);
    expect(walked.checked).toBe(6);
    expect(walked.run.map((entry) => entry.line.place)).toEqual([9, 10, 11, 12]);
    expect(walked.hole).toBeNull();
    // Two downloads that overlap repeat lines; each is read once.
    expect(walkTail(readTail(input([...all.slice(2, 10), ...all.slice(8)]), head), head, []).run.map((entry) => entry.line.place)).toEqual([9, 10, 11, 12]);
  });

  test("a hole ends the run and is reported; a file that begins above the head's next place is refused", () => {
    const holed = [...all.slice(0, 9), ...all.slice(10)];
    const walked = walkTail(readTail(input(holed), head), head, []);
    expect(walked.run.map((entry) => entry.line.place)).toEqual([9]);
    expect(walked.hole).toEqual({ after: 9, before: 11 });
    expect(() => walkTail(readTail(input(all.slice(9)), head), head, [])).toThrow(refusal);
  });

  test("a changed file refuses everything: a line that does not recompute, another hash at the head's place or at a kept place, a line naming another", () => {
    const changed = all.map((line, i) => (i === 9 ? line.replace('"action":"probe"', '"action":"other"') : line));
    expect(() => readTail(input(changed), head)).toThrow(refusal);
    expect(() => walkTail(readTail(input(all), { seq: 8, hash: "e".repeat(64) }), { seq: 8, hash: "e".repeat(64) }, [])).toThrow(refusal);
    expect(() => walkTail(readTail(input(all), head), head, [{ seq: 3, hash: "f".repeat(64) }])).toThrow(refusal);
    // A line that does not parse, or a time that does not print back as written.
    expect(() => readTail(input([...all.slice(0, 3), "{"]), head)).toThrow(refusal);
    expect(() => readTail(input([all[0]!.replace(AT, "2026-10-10T01:00:00.1230Z")]), head)).toThrow(refusal);
    // A tail of another chain: each line recomputes, but the first above the head names another predecessor.
    const other = chain(12, "other");
    expect(() => walkTail(readTail(input(other), head), head, [])).toThrow(refusal);
  });

  test("the class of a lost decision: a seal by the decision's kind, then a suspension or termination, another measure, a reversal, none", () => {
    expect(decisionClass({ kind: "final", actions: [{ kind: "seal_media" }, { kind: "remove" }] })).toBe("seal_final");
    expect(decisionClass({ kind: "interim", actions: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] })).toBe("seal_interim");
    expect(decisionClass({ kind: "final", actions: [{ kind: "suspend" }] })).toBe("standing");
    expect(decisionClass({ kind: "final", actions: [{ kind: "remove" }, { kind: "strike" }] })).toBe("restriction");
    expect(decisionClass({ kind: "correction", actions: [{ kind: "restore" }] })).toBe("reversal");
    expect(decisionClass({ kind: "final", actions: [] })).toBe("no_measure");
  });

  test("the commands' words: kept places, and --after a place", () => {
    expect(parseRestoreArgs("restore-import", [`7:${"a".repeat(64)}`])).toEqual({ command: "restore-import", kept: [{ seq: 7, hash: "a".repeat(64) }] });
    expect(() => parseRestoreArgs("restore-import", ["7:xyz"])).toThrow(/not a kept place/);
    expect(parseRestoreArgs("audit-export", [])).toEqual({ command: "audit-export", after: null });
    expect(parseRestoreArgs("audit-export", ["--after", "40"])).toEqual({ command: "audit-export", after: 40 });
    expect(() => parseRestoreArgs("audit-export", ["--after", "-1"])).toThrow(/--after/);
    expect(parseStaffArgs(["restore-import"])).toEqual({ command: "restore", restore: { command: "restore-import", kept: [] } });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { RestoreView, StaffOverview, type GapClass } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RECOVERY_TABLES, aPost, act, decisionParams, hex64, imagePost, report, restoreForTest, rowCounts, snapshotForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";

import { TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * After a restore, over HTTP (3f design, sections 7.17, 8.8, 10.2, 10.3 and 10.6; invariants 18 and 24): GET
 * /api/staff/restore behind the staff session lists every open gap by class, in the order to take it again, with the
 * gap's members and nothing of its lost row, whether the app's site may open and the newest import's time; "Not needed"
 * needs the key, refuses a moderator (admin_required) and a closed gap (gap_mismatch), and answers the view; the decide
 * route's query member `gap` closes the gap with the decision in its transaction and names it in the audit row, and a
 * gap the decision does not fit is refused with nothing written; the home screen's overview counts the open gaps. The
 * gaps are written as the import writes them, as the migrator. The file restores the database it found.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: After a restore over HTTP", () => {
  let w: RecoveryWorld;
  let moderator: ConsoleStaff;
  let admin: ConsoleStaff;
  let found: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const importId = randomUUID();
  let place = 100;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = recoveryWorld();
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...RECOVERY_TABLES]);
    found = await snapshotForTest(w.migrateDb);
    moderator = await w.staff("moderator");
    admin = await w.staff("admin");
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A gap as the import writes it, as the migrator: one import, the next place, the lost row's action, target and metadata. */
  async function gapOf(cls: GapClass, action: string, target: { type: string; id: string } | null, metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {}, actedAt = "2026-10-03T07:00:00.000Z"): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, imported_at, class)
      values (${importId}::uuid, ${place++}, ${hex64()}, ${action}, ${target?.type ?? null}, ${target?.id ?? null}, ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb, ${actedAt}::timestamptz, now(), ${cls})
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  }
  async function view(s: ConsoleStaff): Promise<RestoreView> {
    const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/restore");
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    const raw: unknown = await res.json();
    const read = RestoreView.parse(raw);
    expect(raw).toStrictEqual(read);
    return read;
  }
  const notNeeded = async (s: ConsoleStaff, gap: string, key = true) => {
    const params = { disposition: "not_needed" as const };
    const stepUp = key ? await w.confirmation(s, { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id: gap }, params }) : undefined;
    return s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/restore/gaps/${gap}/close`, { json: { ...params, ...(stepUp ? { stepUp } : {}) }, headers: MARKED });
  };

  test("every route stands behind the staff session", async () => {
    const stranger = new Browser(w.app, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, { base: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, csrfCookie: "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf", csrfHeader: "x-staff-csrf" });
    expect((await stranger.fetch("/api/staff/restore")).status).toBe(401);
    expect((await stranger.fetch(`/api/staff/restore/gaps/${randomUUID()}/close`, { json: { disposition: "not_needed" }, csrf: false })).status).toBe(401);
  });

  test("the view lists the open gaps by class in the order to take them again, with their members only; the site stays closed while a disabling or a seal is open", async () => {
    expect((await view(moderator)).importedAt).toBeNull();
    const reviewed = await gapOf("reversal", "appeals_reviewed", { type: "decision", id: randomUUID() }, { params: { actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] } });
    const removal = await gapOf("restriction", "case_decided", { type: "case", id: randomUUID() }, { params: { actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] } });
    const effect = await gapOf("order_effect", "order_effected", { type: "order_item", id: randomUUID() });
    const seal = await gapOf("seal_final", "case_decided", { type: "case", id: randomUUID() }, { params: { actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }], authority: "do not leak" } });
    const v = await view(moderator);
    expect(v.importedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(v.gaps.map((gap) => [gap.id, gap.class])).toEqual([
      [effect, "order_effect"],
      [seal, "seal_final"],
      [removal, "restriction"],
      [reviewed, "reversal"],
    ]);
    expect(v.gaps.find((gap) => gap.id === removal)!.kinds).toEqual(["remove", "strike"]);
    expect(v.gaps.find((gap) => gap.id === effect)!.kinds).toEqual(["disable_by_order"]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(v)).not.toContain("do not leak");
    expect([v.mayOpen, v.retentionMay]).toEqual([false, false]);
    const overview = StaffOverview.parse(await (await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/overview")).json());
    expect(overview.restore).toEqual({ open: 4, measures: 3, importedAt: v.importedAt });
    // Closed as not needed by an admin with the key, the disabling and the seal no longer keep the site closed.
    for (const gap of [effect, seal]) expect((await notNeeded(admin, gap)).status).toBe(201);
    const after = await view(moderator);
    expect([after.mayOpen, after.retentionMay]).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(after.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.closedAt === null).map((gap) => gap.id)).toEqual([removal, reviewed]);
  });

  test("Not needed: refused without the key and to a moderator, refused for a closed gap, and answered with the view for an admin", async () => {
    const gap = await gapOf("no_measure", "case_decided", { type: "case", id: randomUUID() });
    expect(await w.refusal(await notNeeded(admin, gap, false))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_required"]);
    expect(await w.refusal(await notNeeded(moderator, gap))).toEqual([403, "admin_required"]);
    const res = await notNeeded(admin, gap);
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(201);
    const closed = RestoreView.parse(await res.json()).gaps.find((g) => g.id === gap)!;
    expect([closed.disposition, closed.closedByDecisionId, closed.closedAt !== null]).toEqual(["not_needed", null, true]);
    expect(await w.refusal(await notNeeded(admin, gap))).toEqual([409, "gap_mismatch"]);
    expect(await w.refusal(await notNeeded(admin, randomUUID()))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
  });

  test("the decide route's `gap`: a decision that fits closes it in its transaction and its audit row names it; one that does not fit is refused with nothing written", async () => {
    const p = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 0);
    const { caseId } = await report(w.apiDb, aPost(p.postId));
    const decide = async (gap: string) => {
      const params = await decisionParams(w.apiDb, moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const stepUp = await w.confirmation(moderator, { action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: caseId }, params });
      return moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions?gap=${gap}`, { json: { ...params, stepUp }, headers: MARKED });
    };
    const seal = await gapOf("seal_final", "case_decided", { type: "case", id: caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: p.postId } });
    const decisions = async () => Number((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.decisions where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`))[0]!.n);
    expect(await w.refusal(await decide(seal))).toEqual([409, "gap_mismatch"]);
    expect(await decisions()).toBe(0);
    const removal = await gapOf("restriction", "case_decided", { type: "case", id: caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: p.postId } });
    const res = await decide(removal);
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(201);
    await w.moderation.settle();
    const [gap] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; closed_by: string }>(sql`select disposition, closed_by from public.restore_gaps where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
    const [audit] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ gap: string; decision: string }>(
      sql`select metadata ->> 'gapId' as gap, metadata ->> 'decisionId' as decision from public.audit_log where action = 'case_decided' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(gap).toEqual({ disposition: "reapplied", closed_by: audit!.decision });
    expect(audit!.gap).toBe(removal);
    // A malformed gap is the validator's refusal, before the key is read.
    expect((await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions?gap=NOT-A-GAP`, { json: {}, headers: MARKED })).status).toBe(400);
  });

  test("leaves the database as the file found it", async () => {
    await w.moderation.settle();
    await restoreForTest(w.migrateDb, found);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...RECOVERY_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/recovery-export.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { AuditExportLine, AuditPage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { canonicalText, chainHash } from "../../src/staff";
import { RECOVERY_TABLES, restoreForTest, rowCounts, snapshotForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { MARKED, recoveryWorld, type ConsoleStaff, type RecoveryWorld } from "./recovery-harness";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * The daily copy over HTTP (3f design, sections 6.6, 7.16, 8.7 and 10.5; invariant 29): the download of the audit log's
 * tail is a confirmed action, refused without the key, and with it writes one row, its confirmed audit row
 * audit_exported, and no mark; its lines carry the chain's members as stored, so each hash recomputes off the server with
 * the canonical text alone. The mark records the copy, with the plain audit row copy_marked, only when the place holds the
 * hash and the caller's own newest confirmed download released that place; a download cut short records nothing, and the
 * next starts at the same place. A download by someone who did not take the last copy alerts every staff account
 * (copy_taken). staff.js audit-export marks under the system actor. The page carries the reader's newest copied place and
 * each row's key, and lists what one key confirmed in a period. The file restores the database it found.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the daily copy of the audit log's tail", () => {
  let w: RecoveryWorld;
  let keeper: ConsoleStaff;
  let other: ConsoleStaff;
  let found: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let head = 0;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = recoveryWorld();
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...RECOVERY_TABLES]);
    found = await snapshotForTest(w.migrateDb);
    keeper = await w.staff("moderator");
    other = await w.staff("admin");
    await filler(250);
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.close();
  });

  /** Rows of the server's own, committed, so that a download spans a few hundred places. */
  async function filler(n: number): Promise<void> {
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, metadata) select ${SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID}::uuid, 'filler', jsonb_build_object('n', n) from generate_series(1, ${n}::int) n`);
  }
  const page = async (s: ConsoleStaff, query = "") => {
    const res = await s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/audit${query}`);
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return AuditPage.parse(await res.json());
  };
  const newestPlace = async () => Number((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ seq: string }>(sql`select seq::text as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`))[0]!.seq);
  /** The download of the places after `after` up to `through`, confirmed with the member's key unless `key` is false. */
  async function download(s: ConsoleStaff, after: number, through: number, key = true): Promise<Response> {
    const params = { after, through };
    const stepUp = key ? await w.confirmation(s, { action: "audit_exported", target: { type: "audit", id: String(through) }, params }) : undefined;
    return s.b.fetch("/api/staff/audit/export", { json: { ...params, ...(stepUp ? { stepUp } : {}) }, headers: MARKED });
  }
  const linesOf = (text: string) => text.split(LF).filter((line) => line !== "").map((line) => AuditExportLine.parse(JSON.parse(line)));
  const recomputes = (line: ReturnType<typeof linesOf>[number]) =>
    chainHash(
      line.prevHash,
      canonicalText({
        chainVersion: line.v,
        chainSeq: line.place,
        id: line.id,
        createdAt: new Date(line.at),
        actorId: line.actor,
        action: line.action,
        targetType: line.targetType,
        targetId: line.targetId,
        requestId: line.requestId,
        staffSession: line.staffSession,
        keyId: line.keyId,
        actionHash: line.actionHash,
        stepUpText: line.stepUp,
        metadataText: line.metadata,
      }),
    ) === line.hash;
  const marksOf = async (staffId: string) => (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ place: number }>(sql`select place::int from public.copy_marks where staff_id = ${staffId}::uuid order by id`)).map((r) => r.place);

  test("the download needs the key; with it, it writes its confirmed row audit_exported alone and no mark, and every line recomputes off the server", async () => {
    const first = await page(keeper);
    expect(first.copy).toEqual({ lastPlace: null });
    head = first.entries[0]!.seq;
    expect(await w.refusal(await download(keeper, 0, head, false))).toEqual([403, "staff_step_up_required"]);
    const res = await download(keeper, 0, head);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("content-type")).toBe("application/x-ndjson");
    expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("private, no-store");
    expect(res.headers.get("content-disposition")).toBe(`attachment; filename="korbat-audit-1-${head}.jsonl"`);
    const lines = linesOf(await res.text());
    expect(lines.map((line) => line.place)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: head }, (_, i) => i + 1));
    expect(lines.every(recomputes)).toBe(true);
    for (const [i, line] of lines.entries()) if (i > 0) expect(line.prevHash).toBe(lines[i - 1]!.hash);
    // A line holds the row's metadata as stored: the page never shows it.
    expect(lines.some((line) => line.metadata.includes('"n": '))).toBe(true);
    const [exported] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ actor: string; target: string; params: unknown; stepped: boolean }>(
      sql`select actor_id::text as actor, target_id as target, metadata -> 'params' as params, step_up is not null as stepped from public.audit_log where action = 'audit_exported' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(exported).toEqual({ actor: keeper.id, target: String(head), params: { after: 0, through: head }, stepped: true });
    expect(await marksOf(keeper.id)).toEqual([]);
    // A download that would end after the newest place is refused once the key has confirmed it.
    expect(await w.refusal(await download(keeper, head, (await newestPlace()) + 1000))).toEqual([422, "invalid_request"]);
  });

  test("the mark: refused for another hash, for a place the caller's newest confirmed download did not release, and for a caller who downloaded nothing; then the copy is recorded with copy_marked", async () => {
    // The keeper's newest confirmed download now releases places after `head` (the refused one above): download again.
    const res = await download(keeper, 0, head);
    const lines = linesOf(await res.text());
    const last = lines[lines.length - 1]!;
    const mark = (s: ConsoleStaff, body: unknown) => s.b.fetch("/api/staff/audit/export/mark", { json: body, headers: MARKED });
    expect(await w.refusal(await mark(keeper, { through: head, hash: "0".repeat(64) }))).toEqual([409, "copy_mismatch"]);
    expect(await w.refusal(await mark(keeper, { through: head - 1, hash: lines[lines.length - 2]!.hash }))).toEqual([409, "copy_mismatch"]);
    expect(await w.refusal(await mark(other, { through: head, hash: last.hash }))).toEqual([409, "copy_mismatch"]);
    expect(await marksOf(keeper.id)).toEqual([]);
    const marked = await mark(keeper, { through: head, hash: last.hash });
    expect(marked.status, await marked.clone().text()).toBe(204);
    expect(await marksOf(keeper.id)).toEqual([head]);
    const [row] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ actor: string; meta: unknown; stepped: boolean }>(
      sql`select actor_id::text as actor, metadata as meta, step_up is not null as stepped from public.audit_log where action = 'copy_marked' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(row).toEqual({ actor: keeper.id, meta: { after: 0, through: head, rows: head }, stepped: false });
    expect((await page(keeper)).copy).toEqual({ lastPlace: head });
    expect((await page(other)).copy).toEqual({ lastPlace: null });
  });

  test("a download cut short at line 200 leaves its confirmed row and no mark, and the next download starts at the same place", async () => {
    await filler(250);
    const through = await newestPlace();
    const res = await download(keeper, head, through);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const reader = res.body!.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let text = "";
    while (text.split(LF).length <= 200) {
      const chunk = await reader.read();
      if (chunk.done) break;
      text += decoder.decode(chunk.value, { stream: true });
    }
    await reader.cancel();
    expect(text.split(LF).length).toBeGreaterThan(200);
    const [exported] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ params: unknown }>(sql`select metadata -> 'params' as params from public.audit_log where action = 'audit_exported' and actor_id = ${keeper.id}::uuid order by chain_seq desc limit 1`);
    expect(exported!.params).toEqual({ after: head, through });
    expect(await marksOf(keeper.id)).toEqual([head]);
    expect((await page(keeper)).copy).toEqual({ lastPlace: head });
  });

  test("a download by an account that did not take the last copy alerts every staff account (copy_taken); the last downloader's own does not", async () => {
    const since = new Date();
    const taken = async () =>
      w.migrateDb.execute<{ rows: number }>(sql`select (facts ->> 'rows')::int as rows from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'copy_taken' and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz order by id`);
    const through = await newestPlace();
    expect((await download(other, 0, 10)).status).toBe(200);
    await w.moderation.settle();
    expect((await taken()).map((r) => r.rows)).toEqual([10]);
    expect((await download(keeper, head, through)).status).toBe(200);
    await w.moderation.settle();
    expect((await taken()).map((r) => r.rows)).toEqual([10]);
  });

  test("staff.js audit-export prints the lines and marks the copy under the system actor, which no staff member's newest copy is", async () => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    const notes: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(["audit-export", "--after", String(head)], { DATABASE_URL_API: w.config.DATABASE_URL_API }, { log: (line) => out.push(line), error: (line) => notes.push(line) });
    expect(code).toBe(0);
    const lines = out.map((line) => AuditExportLine.parse(JSON.parse(line)));
    expect(lines[0]!.place).toBe(head + 1);
    expect(lines.every(recomputes)).toBe(true);
    expect(notes).toEqual([`audit-export: places ${head + 1} to ${lines[lines.length - 1]!.place}, ${lines.length} rows.`]);
    expect(await marksOf(SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID)).toEqual([lines[lines.length - 1]!.place]);
    expect((await page(keeper)).copy).toEqual({ lastPlace: head });
    const [row] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ actor: string }>(sql`select actor_id::text as actor from public.audit_log where action = 'copy_marked' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`);
    expect(row!.actor).toBe(SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID);
    // From its own newest copy when no place is given: only the mark's own row is newer now.
    const again: string[] = [];
    expect(await runStaffCommand(["audit-export"], { DATABASE_URL_API: w.config.DATABASE_URL_API }, { log: (line) => again.push(line), error: () => undefined })).toBe(0);
    expect(again.map((line) => (JSON.parse(line) as { action: string }).action)).toEqual(["copy_marked"]);
  });

  test("the page names each row's key, and lists what one key confirmed in a period", async () => {
    const all = await page(keeper);
    const confirmed = all.entries.find((entry) => entry.action === "audit_exported" && entry.actionHash !== null)!;
    expect(confirmed.keyId).not.toBeNull();
    expect(all.entries.filter((entry) => entry.actionHash === null).every((entry) => entry.keyId === null)).toBe(true);
    const byKey = await page(keeper, `?key=${confirmed.keyId}`);
    expect(byKey.entries.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(byKey.entries.every((entry) => entry.keyId === confirmed.keyId && entry.actionHash !== null)).toBe(true);
    const later = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60_000).toISOString();
    expect((await page(keeper, `?key=${confirmed.keyId}&from=${later}`)).entries).toEqual([]);
    const res = await keeper.b.fetch(`/api/staff/audit?from=${later}`);
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
  });

  test("leaves the database as the file found it", async () => {
    await w.moderation.settle();
    await restoreForTest(w.migrateDb, found);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...RECOVERY_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/recovery-gaps.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { GAP_CLASSES, GAP_DISPOSITIONS, ORDER_RULES, type GapClass } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import {
  RECOVERY_TABLES,
  aPost,
  act,
  decideIn,
  hex64,
  imagePost,
  newTestStaff,
  refusal,
  report,
  rowCounts,
  staffProfile,
  type TestStaff,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING } from "./records-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * The restore gaps (3f design, sections 6.6, 6.7 and 7.17; invariants 5, 21 and 24): the CHECKs hold the contracts'
 * lists; the API role reads the gaps and writes none, and inserts a copy mark's two columns alone, whose time the trigger
 * forces; gap_close closes a gap with the decision this transaction made by the acting account, when it fits the gap's
 * class and target, as reapplied, and refuses anything else (gap_mismatch), leaving the gap open; a gap closed as not
 * needed stands only with its confirmed audit row gap_closed on that gap, by an admin, refused at commit otherwise; and
 * delete_restore_gaps keeps every gap a decision closed, and the newest copy mark. The gaps are written as the import
 * writes them, as the migrator, and removed by their import's id; the decisions run in transactions that are rolled back,
 * but for the one real closing, whose rows the last test removes.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the restore gaps", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let real: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const imports: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    // An admin with a real key, for the one closing that commits; its profile leaves with the world, after the last count.
    real = await world.staff("admin");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, RECOVERY_TABLES);
  }, 90_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where import_id = any(${`{${imports.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A gap as the import writes it, as the migrator, committed: the class, the lost row's target and metadata. */
  async function gapOf(cls: GapClass, target: { type: string; id: string } | null = null, metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {}, actedAt = "2026-10-02T08:00:00.000Z"): Promise<string> {
    const importId = randomUUID();
    imports.push(importId);
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, imported_at, class)
      values (${importId}::uuid, 7, ${hex64()}, 'case_decided', ${target?.type ?? null}, ${target?.id ?? null}, ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb, ${actedAt}::timestamptz, now(), ${cls})
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  }
  const gapRow = async (q: Db | DbTx, id: string) =>
    (await q.execute<{ closed: boolean; closed_by: string | null; disposition: string | null }>(sql`select closed_at is not null as closed, closed_by, disposition from public.restore_gaps where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  /** gap_close in a savepoint, so that a refusal leaves the test's transaction usable; answers the code or null. */
  const close = (tx: DbTx, gap: string, decision: string | null, staff: { id: string }) =>
    refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.gap_close(${gap}::uuid, ${decision}::uuid, ${staff.id}::uuid)`)));
  /** One test's world: a transaction of the API's pool that is rolled back, with both staff members' profiles in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
    rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  /** A reported post and a final removal of it by the moderator under R1: the plainest restriction. */
  async function removal(tx: DbTx): Promise<{ postId: string; caseId: string; decisionId: string }> {
    const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
    const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
    return { postId: p.postId, caseId, decisionId: await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }) };
  }

  test("the CHECKs are the contracts' lists; the API role reads the gaps and writes none, and inserts a copy mark's two columns, whose time the trigger forces", async () => {
    const definition = async (table: string, name: string) =>
      (await migrateDb.execute<{ def: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) as def from pg_constraint c where c.conrelid = ${`public.${table}`}::regclass and c.conname = ${name}`))[0]!.def;
    const listed = (def: string) => [...def.matchAll(/'([a-z_]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    expect(listed(await definition("restore_gaps", "restore_gaps_class"))).toEqual([...GAP_CLASSES]);
    expect(listed(await definition("restore_gaps", "restore_gaps_disposition"))).toEqual([...GAP_DISPOSITIONS]);
    const privileges = async (table: string) =>
      (await migrateDb.execute<{ p: string }>(sql`select p from unnest(array['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE']) p where has_table_privilege('korbat_api', ${table}, p) order by p`)).map((r) => r.p);
    expect(await privileges("public.restore_gaps")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await privileges("public.copy_marks")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    const columns = await migrateDb.execute<{ column_name: string }>(
      sql`select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'copy_marks' and has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.copy_marks', column_name, 'INSERT') order by column_name`,
    );
    expect(columns.map((c) => c.column_name)).toEqual(["place", "staff_id"]);
    for (const fn of ["public.gap_close(uuid, uuid, uuid)", "public.delete_restore_gaps(timestamptz)"]) {
      expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(sql`select has_function_privilege('korbat_api', ${fn}, 'EXECUTE') as ok`))[0]!.ok, fn).toBe(true);
    }
    const gap = await gapOf("no_measure");
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.restore_gaps set closed_at = now(), disposition = 'not_needed' where id = ${gap}::uuid`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where id = ${gap}::uuid`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      const [mark] = await tx.execute<{ fresh: boolean }>(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3) returning at > now() - interval '1 minute' as fresh`);
      expect(mark!.fresh).toBe(true);
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place, at) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3, now() - interval '9 days')`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
    });
    // The migrator's own time is forced too: a mark is the database's clock when it joined.
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const [mark] = await tx.execute<{ fresh: boolean }>(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place, at) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3, now() - interval '9 days') returning at > now() - interval '1 minute' as fresh`);
      expect(mark!.fresh).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  test("a decision taken again closes the gap it fits, in its own transaction, as reapplied by that decision; a closed gap is refused", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const r = await removal(tx);
      const gap = await gapOf("restriction", { type: "case", id: r.caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: r.postId } });
      expect(await close(tx, gap, r.decisionId, mod)).toBeNull();
      expect(await gapRow(tx, gap)).toEqual({ closed: true, closed_by: r.decisionId, disposition: "reapplied" });
      expect(await close(tx, gap, r.decisionId, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      // An unknown gap is not found.
      expect(await close(tx, randomUUID(), r.decisionId, mod)).toBe("not_found");
    });
  });

  test("gap_close refuses a decision that does not fit, and leaves the gap open: another class, another target, another account's, one this transaction did not make", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const r = await removal(tx);
      const other = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      for (const cls of ["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "standing", "reversal", "record"] as const) {
        const gap = await gapOf(cls, { type: "case", id: r.caseId });
        expect(await close(tx, gap, r.decisionId, mod), cls).toBe("gap_mismatch");
        expect((await gapRow(tx, gap)).closed, cls).toBe(false);
      }
      const elsewhere = await gapOf("restriction", { type: "case", id: r.caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: other.postId } });
      expect(await close(tx, elsewhere, r.decisionId, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      const fits = await gapOf("restriction", { type: "case", id: r.caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: r.postId } });
      expect(await close(tx, fits, r.decisionId, admin)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      // A decision of another transaction (committed before this one began) is no decision taken again here.
      const [old] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.decisions where id <> ${r.decisionId}::uuid order by decided_at limit 1`);
      if (old !== undefined) expect(await close(tx, fits, old.id, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      expect((await gapRow(tx, fits)).closed).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  test("each class's fit: a seal while deciding and for good, a reversal, a decision without a measure; a gap that names no target takes any", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      // Seals, on posts reported on the path for child sexual abuse material.
      const sealDeciding = await imagePost(tx, 2);
      const deciding = await report(tx, aPost(sealDeciding.postId), "csam");
      const interim = await decideIn(tx, mod, deciding.caseId, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
      const interimGap = await gapOf("seal_interim", null, { target: { type: "post", id: sealDeciding.postId } });
      expect(await close(tx, await gapOf("seal_final"), interim, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      expect(await close(tx, interimGap, interim, mod)).toBeNull();
      const forGood = await decideIn(tx, admin, deciding.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
      expect(await close(tx, await gapOf("seal_interim"), forGood, admin)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      expect(await close(tx, await gapOf("seal_final"), forGood, admin)).toBeNull();
      // A reversal: a correction that lifts a removal.
      const r = await removal(tx);
      const lifted = await decideIn(tx, admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.decisionId, actions: [act("restore")] });
      expect(await close(tx, await gapOf("restriction"), lifted, admin)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      expect(await close(tx, await gapOf("reversal", null, { target: { type: "post", id: r.postId } }), lifted, admin)).toBeNull();
      // No measure: any decision of this transaction, here the removal itself.
      expect(await close(tx, await gapOf("no_measure"), r.decisionId, mod)).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("Not needed: only an admin, and only with its confirmed audit row gap_closed on that gap, which the commit checks; with it, it stands", async () => {
    const plain = async (staff: { id: string }, gap: string, audit: "none" | "plain" | "other") => {
      return refusal(
        apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
          await tx.execute(sql`select public.gap_close(${gap}::uuid, null, ${staff.id}::uuid)`);
          if (audit !== "none") {
            await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata)
                                 values (${staff.id}::uuid, 'gap_closed', 'restore_gap', ${audit === "plain" ? gap : randomUUID()}, '{}'::jsonb)`);
          }
        }),
      );
    };
    const gap = await gapOf("no_measure");
    expect(await plain(mod, gap, "plain")).toBe("admin_required");
    for (const audit of ["none", "plain", "other"] as const) expect(await plain(admin, gap, audit), audit).toBe("gap_mismatch");
    expect((await gapRow(apiDb, gap)).closed).toBe(false);
    // With a real key: the module's own closing, its audit row confirmed by the admin's key on exactly this gap.
    const confirmed = await world.confirmAction(real, { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id: gap }, params: { disposition: "not_needed" } });
    const view = await world.moderation.forStaff.closeGap(real.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    expect(typeof view).toBe("object");
    expect(await gapRow(apiDb, gap)).toEqual({ closed: true, closed_by: null, disposition: "not_needed" });
    const [audited] = await apiDb.execute<{ action: string; target: string; stepped: boolean }>(
      sql`select action, target_id as target, step_up is not null as stepped from public.audit_log where actor_id = ${real.id}::uuid order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(audited).toEqual({ action: "gap_closed", target: gap, stepped: true });
    // A second closing of the same gap is refused before anything is written.
    const again = await world.confirmAction(real, { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id: gap }, params: { disposition: "not_needed" } });
    expect(await refusal(world.moderation.forStaff.closeGap(real.session, again, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` }))).toBe("gap_mismatch");
  });

  test("delete_restore_gaps: a gap closed as not needed or imported goes 12 months on, a gap a decision closed never; the copy marks that old go, but the newest", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const months = ORDER_RULES.gapKeepMonths;
      const closedGap = async (disposition: "not_needed" | "imported" | "reapplied", monthsAgo: number) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, closed_by, disposition)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 9, ${hex64()}, 'case_decided', now(), now(), 'no_measure', now() - make_interval(months => ${monthsAgo}::int, days => 1),
                  ${disposition === "reapplied" ? sql`gen_random_uuid()` : sql`null`}, ${disposition})
          returning id`);
        return row!.id;
      };
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.copy_marks`);
      const oldNeeded = await closedGap("not_needed", months);
      const oldImported = await closedGap("imported", months);
      const oldReapplied = await closedGap("reapplied", months * 3);
      const young = await closedGap("imported", months - 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3), (${mod.id}::uuid, 5)`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.copy_marks set at = now() - make_interval(months => ${months + 2}::int) where place = 3`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.copy_marks set at = now() - make_interval(months => ${months + 1}::int) where place = 5`);
      // Not before its period: a cut-off younger than gap_keep_months is refused.
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.delete_restore_gaps(now() - make_interval(months => ${months - 1}::int))`)))).toBe("not_due");
      const [done] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.delete_restore_gaps(now() - make_interval(months => ${months}::int)) as n`);
      expect(done!.n).toBe(3);
      const left = (await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.restore_gaps where id = any(${`{${[oldNeeded, oldImported, oldReapplied, young].join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`)).map((r) => r.id).sort();
      expect(left).toEqual([oldReapplied, young].sort());
      expect((await tx.execute<{ place: number }>(sql`select place::int from public.copy_marks`)).map((r) => r.place)).toEqual([5]);
    });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where import_id = any(${`{${imports.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    // The real closing's audit row stays, as every audit row does; its staff account goes with the world.
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, RECOVERY_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/recovery-harness.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pino from "pino";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { ErrorEnvelope, StaffStepUpOptionsResponse, type AuthenticationResponseJSON, type StaffStepUpOptionsRequest } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth, type Auth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration, type Moderation } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { createStaff } from "../../src/staff";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { casesMedia } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { DEVICE_BOUND, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount } from "./staff-fixtures";

/**
 * The console's side of recovery over HTTP (3f Task 6): the real app with the staff routes, staff accounts with a key
 * enrolled through the flow and signed in from the console's browser, and the key's confirmation of any action, asked for
 * as the console asks for it. recovery-export and http-staff-restore build their world with it.
 */

export const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
export const MARKED = { "x-staff-activity": "1" };

export interface ConsoleStaff {
  id: string;
  handle: string;
  b: Browser;
  assert(challenge: string): AuthenticationResponseJSON;
}

export interface RecoveryWorld {
  config: Config;
  authDb: Db;
  apiDb: Db;
  migrateDb: Db;
  repo: AuthRepo;
  auth: Auth;
  moderation: Moderation;
  mailer: MemoryMailer;
  app: ReturnType<typeof createApp>;
  /** A staff account with a profile and one key, signed in at the console. */
  staff(role: "moderator" | "admin"): Promise<ConsoleStaff>;
  /** The key's confirmation of exactly this action, asked for as the console asks for it. */
  confirmation(s: ConsoleStaff, request: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest): Promise<AuthenticationResponseJSON>;
  /** The status and the code of a refused answer. */
  refusal(res: Response): Promise<[number, string]>;
  /** The staff profiles it made. */
  staffIds: string[];
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

export function recoveryWorld(): RecoveryWorld {
  const config = loadConfig({ ...process.env, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, CONSOLE_RP_ID: "" });
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
  const apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
  const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
  const repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const auth = createAuth({ config, logger, authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer, profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
  const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
  const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore, config, logger });
  const app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, staff: createStaff({ apiDb, auth: auth.forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff }), moderation });
  const staffIds: string[] = [];

  async function staff(role: "moderator" | "admin"): Promise<ConsoleStaff> {
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, role);
    const handle = `r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: user.id, handle, displayName: "Staff" });
    staffIds.push(user.id);
    const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const link = await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id);
    const enrolled = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, soft, link.token);
    let counter = 0;
    const assert = (challenge: string) => soft.get({ credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: ++counter });
    const b = new Browser(app, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, { base: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, csrfCookie: STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE, csrfHeader: "x-staff-csrf" });
    const options = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/options", { method: "POST" });
    const { challenge } = ((await options.json()) as { options: { challenge: string } }).options;
    const signedIn = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", { json: { response: assert(challenge) } });
    expect(signedIn.status, await signedIn.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return { id: user.id, handle, b, assert };
  }

  async function confirmation(s: ConsoleStaff, request: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest): Promise<AuthenticationResponseJSON> {
    const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: request, headers: MARKED });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return s.assert(StaffStepUpOptionsResponse.parse(await res.json()).options.challenge);
  }

  const refusal = async (res: Response): Promise<[number, string]> => [res.status, ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code];

  async function close(): Promise<void> {
    await moderation.settle();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  }

  return { config, authDb, apiDb, migrateDb, repo, auth, moderation, mailer, app, staff, confirmation, refusal, staffIds, close };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/recovery-import.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { parseOrderArgs, orderCommand } from "../../src/cli/orders";
import { parseRecordArgs, recordCommand } from "../../src/cli/records";
import { restoreImport } from "../../src/cli/restore";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { orderView } from "../../src/moderation/orders";
import { exportLines } from "../../src/staff";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { RECOVERY_TABLES, aPost, act, imagePost, moderationDeps, refusal, report, restoreForTest, rowCounts, snapshotForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, effectForTest, effectParams, orderConfig, orderForTest } from "./orders-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * A restore and the import of the keeper's files (3f design, sections 7.17 and 12.3, LAB F on the real code; invariants 5
 * and 18). A backup is taken by snapshotForTest; then work is lost: an order opened and given effect with Section C, a
 * removal decided, a record to an authority opened and answered, the order verified from the shell. The keeper's file is
 * the tail from 300 places before the backup's head, as a keeper holds it. The database is restored by restoreForTest.
 * A tail that begins above the head's next place, a line whose hash does not recompute, a line at the head's place with
 * another hash and a kept place with another hash are each refused whole; a hole is reported and the run before it
 * imported. The import writes again the order with its original times and its verification, the item's first disabling
 * and preservation (the post is frozen at once, before any measure is back), the owed record with its original opening,
 * and one gap for each lost decision and each later step of a record; never a decision or a measure, and the migrator's
 * own copy of the lost decision is refused at commit. A disabling taken again keeps its times and closes its gap; the
 * removal taken again closes its own and its statement names the lost day. The file restores the database it found.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: a restore, and the import of the keeper's files", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let mod: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let found: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  // Read in beforeAll: the files are collected without the test environment.
  let appOrigin: string;
  // The backup's head, the keeper's file, and what the lost work made.
  let head: { seq: number; hash: string };
  let tail: string[] = [];
  let backups: string[] = [];
  let orderId: string;
  let itemId: string;
  let orderPost: string;
  let removalCase: string;
  let removalDecision: string;
  let recordId: string;
  let lostDecision: { decision: unknown; actions: unknown[] };
  let lostEffectAt: string;
  let lostRemovalAt: string;
  let lostOrderOpenedAt: string;

  const readHead = async () => {
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ seq: string; hash: string }>(sql`select seq::text as seq, hash from public.audit_head where id = 1`);
    return { seq: Number(row!.seq), hash: row!.hash };
  };
  const input = (lines: readonly string[]) => Buffer.from(lines.map((line) => line + LF).join(""), "utf8");
  const placeOf = (line: string) => (JSON.parse(line) as { place: number }).place;
  const count = async (table: string) => Number((await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql.raw(`select count(*)::int as n from public.${table}`)))[0]!.n);

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    appOrigin = config.APP_ORIGIN;
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    // The database as this file found it, which its last test puts back.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...RECOVERY_TABLES]);
    found = await snapshotForTest(migrateDb);
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    mod = await world.staff("moderator");
    admin = await world.staff("admin");

    // Before the backup: the posts, the report on the second, and enough rows that the keeper's file starts 300 places
    // before the head.
    orderPost = (await imagePost(apiDb, 0)).postId;
    const removed = await imagePost(apiDb, 0);
    removalCase = (await report(apiDb, aPost(removed.postId))).caseId;
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, metadata) select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, 'filler', jsonb_build_object('n', n) from generate_series(1, 320) n`);
    head = await readHead();
    backups = [await snapshotForTest(migrateDb), await snapshotForTest(migrateDb)];

    // The lost work.
    const view = await orderForTest(apiDb, mod, { kind: "tco_removal", sectionC: true, posts: [orderPost] });
    orderId = view.id;
    itemId = view.items[0]!.id;
    const effected = await effectForTest(world, mod, orderId, effectParams(view));
    if (typeof effected === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${effected}`);
    const decided = await world.decideAs(mod, removalCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    if (typeof decided === "string") throw new Error(`the removal was not recorded: ${decided}`);
    removalDecision = decided.decisionId;
    const opened = await recordCommand(migrateDb, parseRecordArgs("notification-open", ["--case", removalCase, "--duty", "voluntary"]), async () => Buffer.alloc(0));
    if (!opened.ok) throw new Error(opened.problem);
    recordId = /record ([0-9a-f-]{36})/.exec(opened.lines[0]!)![1]!;
    const answered = await recordCommand(
      migrateDb,
      parseRecordArgs("notification-event", [recordId, "--kind", "note", "--at", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "a note on the record"]),
      async () => Buffer.alloc(0),
    );
    if (!answered.ok) throw new Error(answered.problem);
    const verified = await orderCommand(migrateDb, parseOrderArgs("order-verify", [orderId, "--how", "compared with the register"]), { homeState: "DE", appOrigin }, async () => Buffer.alloc(0));
    if (!verified.ok) throw new Error(verified.problem);
    const [decision] = await migrateDb.execute<{ row: unknown }>(sql`select to_jsonb(d) as row from public.decisions d where d.id = ${removalDecision}::uuid`);
    const actions = await migrateDb.execute<{ row: unknown }>(sql`select to_jsonb(a) as row from public.decision_actions a where a.decision_id = ${removalDecision}::uuid`);
    lostDecision = { decision: decision!.row, actions: actions.map((a) => a.row) };
    const times = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; at: string; meta: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at, metadata as meta from public.audit_log where chain_seq > ${head.seq} order by chain_seq`,
    );
    lostEffectAt = times.find((t) => t.action === "order_effected")!.at;
    lostRemovalAt = times.find((t) => t.action === "case_decided")!.at;
    lostOrderOpenedAt = String(times.find((t) => t.action === "order_opened")!.meta.openedAt);

    // The keeper's file: from 300 places before the backup's head to the newest row.
    const through = (await readHead()).seq;
    for await (const line of exportLines(apiDb, head.seq - 300, through)) tail.push(JSON.stringify(line));
  }, 300_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  test("the keeper's file holds the 300 places before the head and every lost row, oldest first", () => {
    expect(placeOf(tail[0]!)).toBe(head.seq - 299);
    const actions = tail.filter((line) => placeOf(line) > head.seq).map((line) => (JSON.parse(line) as { action: string }).action);
    expect(actions).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["order_opened", "order_effected", "case_decided", "notification_recorded", "order_recorded"]));
  });

  test("after the restore the lost work is gone: no order, the post public, the head the backup's", async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, backups[0]!);
    expect(await readHead()).toEqual(head);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute(sql`select 1 from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid`)).length).toBe(0);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state::text from public.posts where id = ${orderPost}::uuid`))[0]!.state).toBe("visible");
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ frozen: boolean }>(sql`select public.post_preserved(${orderPost}::uuid) as frozen`))[0]!.frozen).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a changed file is refused whole and writes nothing: a tail that begins above the head's next place, a line that does not recompute, another hash at the head's place or at a kept place", async () => {
    const gapsBefore = await count("restore_gaps");
    const refusedWith = async (lines: readonly string[], kept: { seq: number; hash: string }[] = []) => {
      const done = await restoreImport(migrateDb, kept, input(lines), appOrigin);
      expect(done.ok).toBe(false);
      if (!done.ok) expect(done.problem).toMatch(new RegExp(`^restore-import: refused: line [0-9]+ does not continue the restored head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}; nothing was written$`));
    };
    await refusedWith(tail.filter((line) => placeOf(line) > head.seq + 1));
    const changed = tail.map((line) => (placeOf(line) === head.seq + 1 ? line.replace("Bundeskriminalamt", "Bundesamt") : line));
    await refusedWith(changed);
    const other = tail.map((line) => (placeOf(line) === head.seq ? line.replace(head.hash, "e".repeat(64)) : line));
    await refusedWith(other);
    await refusedWith(tail, [{ seq: head.seq - 10, hash: "f".repeat(64) }]);
    expect(await count("restore_gaps")).toBe(gapsBefore);
    expect(await readHead()).toEqual(head);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute(sql`select 1 from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid`)).length).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a hole is reported, not fatal: the run up to it is imported, the hole printed and in the audit row, nothing behind it", async () => {
    const holed = tail.filter((line) => placeOf(line) !== head.seq + 2);
    const done = await restoreImport(migrateDb, [], input(holed), appOrigin);
    expect(done.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!done.ok) return;
    expect(done.lines[0]).toBe(`restore-import: places ${head.seq + 1} to ${head.seq + 1} continue the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} (300 earlier lines checked, not imported).`);
    expect(done.lines.at(-1)).toBe(`restore-import: the files hold nothing between place ${head.seq + 1} and place ${head.seq + 3}: what happened there is not imported`);
    const [imported] = await migrateDb.execute<{ meta: { holes: number[][]; firstPlace: number; lastPlace: number; files: string[] } }>(
      sql`select metadata as meta from public.audit_log where action = 'restore_imported' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect(imported!.meta.holes).toEqual([[head.seq + 1, head.seq + 3]]);
    expect([imported!.meta.firstPlace, imported!.meta.lastPlace]).toEqual([head.seq + 1, head.seq + 1]);
    expect(imported!.meta.files).toHaveLength(1);
    // The order is back; its effect, behind the hole, is not.
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ disabled: string | null }>(sql`select disabled_at::text as disabled from public.legal_order_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`))[0]!.disabled).toBeNull();
    expect((await migrateDb.execute(sql`select 1 from public.restore_gaps where class = 'order_effect' and target_id = ${itemId}`)).length).toBe(0);
  });

  test("the import writes the records again with their original times and one gap for each lost decision, never a decision or a measure; the post is frozen at once", async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, backups[1]!);
    const decisions = await count("decisions");
    const measures = await count("decision_actions");
    const done = await restoreImport(migrateDb, [{ seq: head.seq - 10, hash: (JSON.parse(tail.find((line) => placeOf(line) === head.seq - 10)!) as { hash: string }).hash }], input(tail), appOrigin);
    expect(done.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!done.ok) return;
    expect(done.lines[0]).toMatch(new RegExp(`^restore-import: places ${head.seq + 1} to [0-9]+ continue the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} [(]300 earlier lines checked, not imported[)][.]$`));
    expect(done.lines).toContain("restore-import: gaps, in the order to take them again:");
    expect(done.lines.some((line) => line.startsWith("restore-import: 1. order_effect, order_item"))).toBe(true);
    expect(done.lines).toContain("restore-import: The app's site stays closed until gaps 1 to 1 are closed on the console's After a restore screen.");
    // No ledger row: the import writes records and gaps alone.
    expect(await count("decisions")).toBe(decisions);
    expect(await count("decision_actions")).toBe(measures);
    const [order] = await migrateDb.execute<{ opened: string; imported: boolean; verified: boolean; section_c: boolean }>(
      sql`select to_char(opened_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as opened, imported_at is not null as imported, verified_at is not null as verified, section_c from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(order).toEqual({ opened: lostOrderOpenedAt, imported: true, verified: true, section_c: true });
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disabled: string; preserve: boolean; decision: string | null }>(
      sql`select to_char(disabled_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as disabled, preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until(disabled_at) as preserve, decision_id as decision
            from public.legal_order_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(item).toEqual({ disabled: lostEffectAt, preserve: true, decision: null });
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ frozen: boolean }>(sql`select public.post_preserved(${orderPost}::uuid) as frozen`))[0]!.frozen).toBe(true);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state::text from public.posts where id = ${orderPost}::uuid`))[0]!.state).toBe("visible");
    const [record] = await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string; imported: boolean; case_id: string }>(
      sql`select state, imported_at is not null as imported, case_id from public.authority_notifications where id = ${recordId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(record).toEqual({ state: "owed", imported: true, case_id: removalCase });
    const gaps = await migrateDb.execute<{ class: string; action: string; open: boolean }>(
      sql`select class, action, closed_at is null as open from public.restore_gaps where place > ${head.seq} order by place, target_id`,
    );
    expect(gaps.filter((g) => g.open).map((g) => [g.class, g.action])).toEqual([
      ["order_effect", "order_effected"],
      ["restriction", "case_decided"],
      ["record", "notification_recorded"],
    ]);
    expect(gaps.filter((g) => !g.open).map((g) => g.action).sort()).toEqual(["notification_recorded", "order_opened", "order_recorded"]);
    const [imported] = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; counts: Record<string, number> }>(
      sql`select action, metadata -> 'counts' as counts from public.audit_log where chain_seq = (select seq from public.audit_head where id = 1)`,
    );
    expect(imported).toEqual({ action: "restore_imported", counts: { order_effect: 1, restriction: 1, record: 4 } });
  });

  test("the migrator's own copy of the lost decision and its measure never commits: decision_holds refuses it without a confirmed audit row", async () => {
    const decisions = await count("decisions");
    const copied = refusal(
      migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.decisions select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.decisions, ${JSON.stringify(lostDecision.decision)}::jsonb)`);
        for (const action of lostDecision.actions) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.decision_actions select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.decision_actions, ${JSON.stringify(action)}::jsonb)`);
      }),
    );
    expect(await copied).not.toBeNull();
    expect(await count("decisions")).toBe(decisions);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state::text from public.posts p join public.cases c on c.target_id = p.id where c.id = ${removalCase}::uuid`))[0]!.state).toBe("visible");
  });

  test("taken again under a key: the disabling keeps its first time and its preservation, its notice stays held, and its gap closes; the removal closes its own, and its statement names the lost day", async () => {
    const view = (await orderView(moderationDeps(apiDb, { config: orderConfig() }), orderId, { role: "moderator" }))!;
    expect(view.items[0]!.gap).toBe(true);
    const again = await effectForTest(world, mod, orderId, effectParams(view));
    if (typeof again === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${again}`);
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disabled: string; preserve: boolean; decision: string }>(
      sql`select to_char(disabled_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as disabled, preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until(${lostEffectAt}::timestamptz) as preserve, decision_id as decision
            from public.legal_order_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect([item!.disabled, item!.preserve]).toEqual([lostEffectAt, true]);
    const [held] = await migrateDb.execute<{ informed: string | null; level: string }>(
      sql`select d.informed_at::text as informed, p.moderation_level::text as level from public.decisions d join public.posts p on p.id = ${orderPost}::uuid where d.id = ${item!.decision}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(held).toEqual({ informed: null, level: "disabled" });
    const [effectGap] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; closed_by: string }>(sql`select disposition, closed_by from public.restore_gaps where class = 'order_effect' and target_id = ${itemId}`);
    expect(effectGap).toEqual({ disposition: "reapplied", closed_by: item!.decision });
    const [removal] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.restore_gaps where class = 'restriction' and closed_at is null and place > ${head.seq}`);
    const decided = await world.decideAs(admin, removalCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }, { gap: removal!.id });
    if (typeof decided === "string") throw new Error(`the removal was not taken again: ${decided}`);
    const [closed] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; closed_by: string }>(sql`select disposition, closed_by from public.restore_gaps where id = ${removal!.id}::uuid`);
    expect(closed).toEqual({ disposition: "reapplied", closed_by: decided.decisionId });
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ gap: string }>(sql`select metadata ->> 'gapId' as gap from public.audit_log where action = 'case_decided' and metadata ->> 'decisionId' = ${decided.decisionId}`);
    expect(audit!.gap).toBe(removal!.id);
    const { decisionStatement } = await import("../../src/moderation/statement");
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, decided.decisionId))!.statement;
    expect(statement.reapplied).toEqual({ lostOn: lostRemovalAt.slice(0, 10) });
  });

  test("leaves the database as the file found it", async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, found);
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...RECOVERY_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
