```ts
        const unmarkable = params.unfounded.filter((itemId) => !found.items.some((each) => each.id === itemId && each.markable && each.outcome === null && each.seq <= params.throughSeq));
        if (unmarkable.length > 0) {
          problem(`${what}: a mark on an item this decision does not answer or that cannot be marked`);
          throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");

        state.decisions.push({ caseId: found.id, params });

        return { status: 201, body: caseAnswer(found) };

    if (reveal) {

      const issued = clientData(input.stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
      if (issued.target !== itemId || input.stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {

      if (!owner || !reason || state.reveals.some((done) => done.reasonDigest === input.reasonDigest)) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
      state.reveals.push({ itemId, reasonDigest: input.reasonDigest });

    }

    if (key === "GET /api/staff/me") return { status: 200, body: me(session) };

        handle: s.handle,
        browser: s.browser,

        lastUsedAt: iso(s.lastUsedAt),
        current: s === session,

      state.exports.push(params);

      state.exportCut = null;

    }

            : action.action === "appeals_reviewed"

              : action.action === "order_event_recorded" || action.action === "order_corrected" || action.action === "order_effected"
                ? state.orders.some((order) => order.id === action.target.id)
                : action.action === "audit_exported"

      if (underDigests.some((digest) => typeof digest === "string" && state.forgedDigests.includes(digest))) problem(`${key}: an action under a digest the page did not compute`);
      state.stepUpOptionsServed += 1;

      // case's next version, which the page never saw.
      let bound: StaffStepUpActionInput = action;

          const extra = order?.items.find((item) => item.postId !== null && !params.items.some((one) => one.itemId === item.id));

    const handle = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice("/api/staff/sessions/".length));
    const { stepUp } = parse(StaffSessionRevokeRequest, body, "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle");
    const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
    if (issued.target !== handle || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {

      throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
    }
    const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));

  }

  /** The staff gate: the console's Host, an Origin on every write and never another, and same-origin fetch metadata. */
  function gate(req: IncomingMessage) {
    if (req.headers.host !== new URL(state.origin).host) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Host ${String(req.headers.host)}`);
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    const site = req.headers["sec-fetch-site"];
    if (site !== undefined && site !== "same-origin") {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Sec-Fetch-Site ${site}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
    const origin = req.headers.origin;
    if ((origin !== undefined || (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD")) && origin !== state.origin) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Origin ${String(origin)}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
  }

  /** Answers one request under /api/staff, as the API behind Caddy's console site would. */
  async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, url: URL, raw: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    let answer: Answer;
    try {
      if (state.off) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      gate(req);
      let body: unknown;
      if (raw.length > 0) {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8"));
        } catch {
          problem(`${req.method} ${url.pathname}: a body that is not JSON`);
          throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
        }
      }
      answer = await route(req, url, body);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof Refusal)) throw err;
      answer = { status: err.status, body: { error: { code: err.code, message: "the fixture's own words" } }, headers: err.headers };
    }
    state.requests.push({ method: req.method ?? "", path: `${url.pathname}${url.search}`, status: answer.status, activity: req.headers["x-staff-activity"] === "1" });
    const headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = { "cache-control": "no-store", ...answer.headers };
    if (answer.raw) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": answer.raw.type, "content-length": String(answer.raw.bytes.length) });
      res.end(answer.raw.bytes);
      return;
    }
    if (answer.body === undefined) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, headers);
      res.end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": "application/json" });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(answer.body));
  }

  return {
    state,
    handle,
    /** Every staff session ends behind the page's back, as a revocation from the command line ends them. */
    endEverySession() {
      state.sessions.clear();
    },
    /**
     * Another staff member decides the case behind the page: a withhold of the post taken while deciding, under rule R6,
     * on the case as it stands. The post is then withheld and the case's version moves on, so a decision the page built
     * on the version it read is answered case_changed.

    decideBehindThePage(caseId: string): void {

      if (!found || !newest) throw new Error("the fixtures hold no such case, or it has no snapshot");
      const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse({
        kind: "interim",
        stateVersion: found.stateVersion,
        throughSeq: 0,
        reviewsDecisionId: null,
        snapshotId: newest.id,
        snapshotDigest: hex64(),
        outcome: "restricted",
        ground: "incompatible",
        ruleId: "R6",
        rulesVersion: 2,
        redressVersion: 1,
        category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6,
        categoryKeyword: null,
        actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }],
        factsDigest: hex64(),
        reasonDigest: hex64(),
        legalReferenceDigest: null,
        // 3e: every decision's params carry the marks and the withdrawal; this one sets neither.
        unfounded: [],
        replaced: false,
      });
      applyDecision(found, params, { facts: "The post repeats one link in every reply.", reason: "That is spam, which rule R6 names.", legalReference: null }, OTHER_STAFF);
      if (found.target.type === "post") found.target = { ...found.target, state: "withheld", level: "withheld" };
    },
    /** A new enrolment link, as `staff.js enroll` prints one for the person's next key; its token. */
    issueEnrolment(): string {
      state.enrolmentToken = b64url(32);
      state.enrolmentUsed = false;
      return state.enrolmentToken;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { BrowserContext, CDPSession, Page } from "playwright-core";

/**
 * Every channel a policy report, a page error or a dialog can reach the check by (console-lab.md, section 2), watched for
 * the whole walk: the page's own securitypolicyviolation events, from a listener installed before any of the page's
 * scripts runs; any Trusted Types policy the page tries to create; Chromium's console, through Playwright and through the
 * CDP Log domain, whose source is "security" for CSP and Trusted Types messages; DevTools issues (the Audits domain), which
 * classify every CSP issue; page errors; dialogs, dismissed; failed requests; and any request that would leave the
 * console's origin, aborted. Everything found is a problem, listed with what it said.
 */

/**
 * Console errors the walk causes on purpose, which Chromium logs for every answer that is not a success, with the statuses
 * the API answers them with: 401 (no session, an ended session), 403 (a synced key refused at enrolment), 404 (the
 * console off), and 400 and 409, which the API answers other refusals of a key or a link with, 409 also a decision on a
 * case that changed; 422, a text the API refuses to save, and 429, a save over the minute's limit. What the page then
 * shows is checked step by step, and a request the fixtures refuse for the page's own fault is one of their problems.
 */
const EXPECTED_HTTP_ERROR = /^Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of (400|401|403|404|409|422|429) /;
const POLICY_TEXT = /Content.Security.Policy|Trusted.?Type|require-trusted-types-for|Refused to/i;

/**
 * Runs in every page before its own scripts, outside its policy (Playwright adds it through CDP). It is plain text, so no
 * test runner's transform can put a helper into it that the page does not have. It reports through the binding below.
 */
const INIT_SCRIPT = `
(() => {
  const report = (kind, detail) => window.__korbatReport(kind, detail);
  document.addEventListener("securitypolicyviolation", (event) => {
    report("securitypolicyviolation", JSON.stringify({
      directive: event.effectiveDirective,
      blocked: event.blockedURI,
      sample: event.sample,
      source: event.sourceFile,
      line: event.lineNumber,
      disposition: event.disposition,
    }));
  }, true);
  // trusted-types 'none' already refuses every policy; this names any the page tries, should the header ever change.
  const factory = window.trustedTypes;
  if (factory && typeof factory.createPolicy === "function") {
    const create = factory.createPolicy.bind(factory);
    factory.createPolicy = (name, rules) => {
      report("a Trusted Types policy created", String(name));
      return create(name, rules);
    };
  }
})();
`;

export interface Watcher {
  /** The page's CDP session, which the walk also drives the virtual authenticator with. */
  cdp: CDPSession;
  /** The problems found since the last call, which it clears. */
  take(): string[];
}

export async function watch(context: BrowserContext, page: Page, origin: string): Promise<Watcher> {
  let problems: string[] = [];
  const found = (text: string) => problems.push(text);

  // The binding is Playwright's, added through CDP, so the page's policy does not apply to it.
  await context.exposeBinding("__korbatReport", (_source, kind: string, detail: string) => found(`${kind}: ${detail}`));
  await context.addInitScript({ content: INIT_SCRIPT });

  const cdp = await context.newCDPSession(page);
  cdp.on("Log.entryAdded", ({ entry }) => {
    if (entry.source === "security" || POLICY_TEXT.test(entry.text)) found(`console (CDP Log, ${entry.source}, ${entry.level}): ${entry.text}`);
    else if ((entry.level === "error" || entry.level === "warning") && !EXPECTED_HTTP_ERROR.test(entry.text)) found(`console (CDP Log, ${entry.source}, ${entry.level}): ${entry.text}`);
  });
  await cdp.send("Log.enable");
  cdp.on("Audits.issueAdded", ({ issue }) => {
    if (issue.code === "ContentSecurityPolicyIssue") found(`DevTools CSP issue: ${JSON.stringify(issue.details.contentSecurityPolicyIssueDetails)}`);
  });
  await cdp.send("Audits.enable");

  page.on("console", (message) => {
    const text = message.text();
    if (POLICY_TEXT.test(text)) found(`console ${message.type()}: ${text}`);
    else if ((message.type() === "error" || message.type() === "warning") && !EXPECTED_HTTP_ERROR.test(text)) found(`console ${message.type()}: ${text}`);
  });
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => found(`page error: ${error.message}`));
  page.on("dialog", (dialog) => {
    found(`dialog (${dialog.type()}): ${dialog.message()}`);
    void dialog.dismiss().catch(() => undefined);
  });
  page.on("requestfailed", (request) => {
    const reason = request.failure()?.errorText ?? "no reason";
    void request.response().then((response) => {
      // Chromium reports a 204 answer as aborted once it has arrived, since there is no body to read (the console's
      // sign-out and revocation). The answer did arrive; a request the policy blocks never gets one.
      if (reason === "net::ERR_ABORTED" && response?.status() === 204) return;
      found(`request failed: ${request.method()} ${request.url()} (${reason})`);
    });
  });
  await context.route("**/*", (route) => {
    const url = route.request().url();
    if (new URL(url).origin === origin) return route.continue();
    found(`a request to another origin, aborted: ${url}`);
    return route.abort();
  });

  return {
    cdp,
    take() {
      const taken = problems;
      problems = [];
      return taken;
    },
  };
}

/**
 * What the page holds that the console never writes: an element that runs or loads something, an inline handler or
 * style, a link that is not one of the console's own pages or a case's or an order's address, a form with an action, or a script other
 * than the bundle. The one image the console draws is a case's, from the staff API on its own origin, by the address its
 * one image site builds; any other image is a problem. Plain text, evaluated in the page, for the reason INIT_SCRIPT is.
 */
const INSPECT_SCRIPT = `
(() => {
  const out = [];
  const root = document.getElementById("root");
  if (!root) return ["the page has no #root"];
  const id = "[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}";
  const casePath = new RegExp("^/cases/" + id + "$");
  const orderPath = new RegExp("^/orders/" + id + "$");
  const imagePath = new RegExp("^/api/staff/cases/" + id + "/media/" + id + "/(small|large)$");
  const caseImage = (element) => element.tagName === "IMG" && imagePath.test(String(element.getAttribute("src")))
    && (element.getAttribute("class") === "evidence" || element.getAttribute("class") === "evidence blurred");
  for (const element of root.querySelectorAll("script, style, link, meta, base, iframe, frame, object, embed, img, svg, math, template, video, audio, source")) {
    if (!caseImage(element)) out.push("a <" + element.tagName.toLowerCase() + "> element");
  }
  for (const element of root.querySelectorAll("*")) {
    for (const name of element.getAttributeNames()) {
      if (name === "src" && caseImage(element)) continue;
      if (name.toLowerCase().startsWith("on") || name === "srcdoc" || name === "style" || name === "src") out.push("a " + name + " attribute on <" + element.tagName.toLowerCase() + ">");
    }
  }
  for (const link of root.querySelectorAll("a")) {
    const href = link.getAttribute("href");
    if (href !== "/" && href !== "/audit" && href !== "/signin" && href !== "/queue" && href !== "/appeals" && href !== "/standing" && href !== "/contact" && href !== "/orders" && href !== "/restore" && !casePath.test(String(href)) && !orderPath.test(String(href))) out.push("a link to " + String(href));
  }
  for (const form of root.querySelectorAll("form")) {
    if (form.hasAttribute("action")) out.push("a form with an action: " + String(form.getAttribute("action")));
  }
  if (document.scripts.length !== 1) out.push(document.scripts.length + " script elements");
  return out;
})()
`;

export function inspect(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  return page.evaluate(INSPECT_SCRIPT) as Promise<string[]>;
}

/** The text of every element holding a string a person wrote (UserText's <bdi>) and of every <code> (actions, targets, hashes). */
export function userTexts(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  return page.evaluate(`[...document.querySelectorAll("bdi, code")].map((element) => element.textContent ?? "")`) as Promise<string[]>;
}

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 8.1 and 8.10): the two rules of a phone's width, which every run at 360 by 740 px is held to. A
 * horizontal scroll bar, and a control smaller than 44 px in either direction. A control is an a, button, input,
 * select, textarea or summary element that is shown; a tick box or a radio button is measured together with its label.
 * Plain text, evaluated in the page, for the reason INIT_SCRIPT is.
 */
const PHONE_SCRIPT = `
(() => {
  const out = [];
  const doc = document.documentElement;
  if (doc.scrollWidth > doc.clientWidth) out.push("a horizontal scroll bar: the page is " + doc.scrollWidth + " px wide in " + doc.clientWidth);
  const shown = (element) => {
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    const style = getComputedStyle(element);
    return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.visibility !== "hidden" && style.display !== "none";
  };
  for (const element of document.querySelectorAll("a, button, input, select, textarea, summary")) {
    if (!shown(element)) continue;
    let box = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (element.tagName === "INPUT" && (element.type === "radio" || element.type === "checkbox")) {
      const label = element.closest("label") || (element.id ? document.querySelector("label[for='" + element.id + "']") : null);
      if (label) {
        const other = label.getBoundingClientRect();
        box = { width: Math.max(box.right, other.right) - Math.min(box.left, other.left), height: Math.max(box.bottom, other.bottom) - Math.min(box.top, other.top) };
      }
    }
    if (box.width < 44 || box.height < 44) {
      const name = (element.textContent || element.getAttribute("name") || element.getAttribute("aria-label") || "").trim().slice(0, 40);
      out.push("a control smaller than 44 px: <" + element.tagName.toLowerCase() + "> " + name + " (" + Math.round(box.width) + " by " + Math.round(box.height) + ")");
    }
  }
  return out;
})()
`;

/** What the page breaks of the phone's two rules, at the viewport it is shown in. */
export function phoneProblems(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  return page.evaluate(PHONE_SCRIPT) as Promise<string[]>;
}
```

```ts
export function sealableCase(id: string, accountId: string): CaseView {
  const fields = { handle: "an_account", displayName: HOSTILE.quote, bio: LOOKALIKE.label };

    redressVersion: 2,

    throughSeq: 1,
    answersFromSeq: 1,
    facts: "The post offers followers for money.",
    reason: "That is spam.",
    actions: [

      { ...decision().actions[0]!, id: "8192a3b4-c5d6-47e8-b90a-1b2c3d4e5f60", kind: "strike", countsUntil: "2026-12-30T09:00:00.000Z", restedOnBy: ["suspend"] },
    ],
  });
  return postCase({
    id: CASE_STRUCK,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    answeredSeq: 1,
    closedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z",
    target: { type: "post", id: POST_ID, link: `http://localhost:8081/post/${POST_ID}`, authorHandle: HOSTILE.bidi, state: "removed", level: "removed" },

}

/**
 * 3e: an account's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report under R4 about its handle, unanswered, with a snapshot
 * whose handle is the one the profile holds now unless told otherwise, and the account's standing. `live` is the handle
 * the profile holds now; `snapped` the one the newest snapshot copied.
 */
export function retireCase(live = "Ada_L", snapped = "Ada_L", standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}): CaseView {
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_RETIRE,
    lane: 2,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: live, displayName: "Ada", bio: "", deleted: false },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, authorHandle: snapped, handle: snapped, displayName: "Ada", bio: "" }],
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_RETIRE, ruleId: "R4", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS", link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada_l" })],
    history: [],
    standing: { ...NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING, ...standing },
  });
}

/** An announced suspension of 3 days, as a decision's row on the case page holds it, with where its period stands and its reply. */
function announcedSuspension(id: string, period: NonNullable<CaseDecisionAction["period"]>, reply: CaseDecisionAction["reply"]): CaseDecisionAction {
  return {
    id,
    kind: "suspend",
    mediaId: null,
    noEffect: null,
    inForce: true,
    reversesActionId: null,
    liftedBy: null,
    sealed: null,
    ...NO_STANDING,
    days: 3,
    announced: true,
    basis: "strikes",
    restsOn: THREE_STRIKES.map((strike) => strike.decisionId),
    earliestStart: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z",
    period,
    reply,
  };
}
```

```tsx
    expect(busy).toMatch(/<button[^>]*disabled=""[^>]*aria-busy="true"|<button[^>]*aria-busy="true"[^>]*disabled=""/);

describe("home", () => {
  const props = {
    me: ME,
    overview: { state: "ready" as const, value: QUIET },
    now: Date.parse("2026-10-01T09:40:00.000Z"),
    onOpenCase: noop,
    signIns: { state: "ready" as const, value: [signIn(HOSTILE.script, 9), signIn(HOSTILE.bidi, 8), signIn(HOSTILE.img, 7)] },
    sessions: { state: "ready" as const, value: SESSIONS },
    keys: { state: "ready" as const, value: KEYS },
    revoking: null,
    notice: null,
    error: null,
    onRevoke: noop,
  };

  test("who is signed in, the role, the session's end, sign-ins, sessions and keys, every string as text", () => {
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} />);
    expectInert(out);
    expect(out).toContain("Signed in until 21:40");
    expect(out).toContain("moderator");
    expect(out).toContain("2026-09-30 08:05");
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE.long);
    expect(out).toContain("javascript:alert(3)");
    // The cases' overview stands before the sign-ins; the placeholder line of 3a is gone.
    expect(out).not.toContain("Cases arrive in sub-project 3c.");
    expect(out).toContain("Urgent: no open case");
    expect(out.indexOf("Urgent: no open case")).toBeLessThan(out.indexOf("Staff sign-ins in the last 7 days"));
  });

  test("Sign out that session on the other sessions, never on this one", () => {
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} />);
    expect(out.match(/>Sign out that session</g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(out).toContain("This session");
  });

  test("a revocation under way, its outcome, and a refusal in the console's words", () => {
    expect(html(<HomeView {...props} revoking={OTHER_SESSION} />)).toMatch(/aria-busy="true"/);
    expect(html(<HomeView {...props} notice="That session is signed out." />)).toContain("That session is signed out.");
    expect(html(<HomeView {...props} error="That confirmation was for another action." />)).toMatch(/role="alert"[^>]*>That confirmation was for another action\./);
  });

  test("no sign-ins, and lists still loading or failed", () => {
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} signIns={{ state: "ready", value: [] }} sessions={{ state: "loading" }} keys={{ state: "failed", message: "Cannot reach the server." }} />);
    expect(out).toContain("No staff sign-ins in the last 7 days.");
    expect(out).toContain("Loading");
    expect(out).toContain("Cannot reach the server.");
  });

  test("opened 11 hours after the page read its session, it lists sign-ins back to 7 days before its own opening", async () => {
    // The page read its session at 09:00 and its person kept acting, so the idle timer never read /me again: the session
    // the page holds still says 09:00 when Home opens at 20:00.
    const pageOpened = Date.parse("2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z");
    const homeOpened = Date.parse("2026-10-01T20:00:00.000Z");
    const at = (createdAt: string, seq: number): AuditEntry => ({ ...signIn("mod_anna", seq), createdAt });
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      "GET /api/staff/me": [{ status: 200, body: makeMe({ at: pageOpened }) }, { status: 200, body: makeMe({ at: homeOpened, absolute: 3600 }) }],
      "GET /api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in": {
        status: 200,
        body: {
          entries: [
            at("2026-10-01T19:00:00.000Z", 40),
            at("2026-09-24T20:30:00.000Z", 39),
            // Older than 7 days at 20:00, though not at the page's stale 09:00: the list ends before it.
            at("2026-09-24T19:30:00.000Z", 38),
            at("2026-09-24T09:30:00.000Z", 37),
          ],
          nextCursor: 37,
          copy: { lastPlace: null },
        },
      },
      "GET /api/staff/sessions": { status: 200, body: { sessions: [] } },
      "GET /api/staff/keys": { status: 200, body: { keys: [] } },
      "GET /api/staff/overview": { status: 200, body: QUIET },
    });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    const store = createConsoleStore({ api, clock: new FakeClock(), path: "/", history: { pushState: noop, replaceState: noop } });
    await store.start();
    const held = store.get().session;
    if (held.kind !== "signed-in") throw new Error("the page holds no session");
    expect(serverNow(held.me)).toBe(pageOpened);

    // What the screen runs when it opens, with the session the page holds as its `me`.
    let signIns: Loadable<AuditEntry[]> = { state: "loading" };
    openHome(api, { current: true }, { overview: noop, signIns: (value) => (signIns = value), sessions: noop, keys: noop });
    await settle();
    expect(signIns).toMatchObject({ state: "ready" });
    const out = html(<HomeView {...props} me={held.me} signIns={signIns} />);
    expect(out).toContain("2026-10-01 19:00");
    expect(out).toContain("2026-09-24 20:30");
    expect(out).not.toContain("2026-09-24 19:30");
    expect(out).not.toContain("2026-09-24 09:30");
    // The screen's own /me, marked as its person's opening of it, came before the first page of sign-ins.
    const asked = fake.requests.map((r) => `${r.url} ${r.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`);
    expect(asked.filter((r) => r.startsWith("/api/staff/me"))).toEqual(["/api/staff/me 1", "/api/staff/me 1"]);
    expect(asked.indexOf("/api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in 1")).toBeGreaterThan(asked.lastIndexOf("/api/staff/me 1"));
    store.dispose();
  });
});

describe("the whole page by the console's state", () => {
  async function page(path: string, table: Parameters<typeof fakeFetch>[0], cookie = "") {
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fakeFetch(table).fetch, cookie: () => cookie });
    const store = createConsoleStore({ api, clock: new FakeClock(), path, history: { pushState: noop, replaceState: noop } });
    await store.start();
    return { store, render: () => html(<App store={store} credentials={fakeCredentials()} signal={undefined} />) };
  }

  test("the home and audit pages for a live session", async () => {
    const home = await page("/", { "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: ME } });
    expect(home.render()).toMatch(/<h2[^>]*>Home</);
    expect(home.render()).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    const audit = await page("/audit", { "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: ME } });
    expect(audit.render()).toMatch(/<h2[^>]*>Audit log</);
  });

  test("sign-in in place, at the same address, when the session ended", async () => {
    const p = await page("/audit", { "GET /api/staff/me": [{ status: 200, body: ME }, { status: 401, body: envelope("staff_session_required") }] });
    await p.store.api.me().catch(() => undefined);
    const out = p.render();
    expect(out).toContain("Your staff session ended.");
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/<h2[^>]*>Audit log</);
  });

  test("reopened after its session ended while no page held it, the page says the session ended, at the same address", async () => {
    // The staff CSRF cookie is set only by a sign-in and lasts the session's 12 hours; only a sign-out or this 401 clears it.
    const p = await page("/audit", { "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 401, body: envelope("staff_session_required") } }, "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf=t");
    const out = p.render();
    expect(out).toContain("Your staff session ended.");
    expect(out).toContain("Sign in with your staff key");
    expect(p.store.get().path).toBe("/audit");
  });

  test("opened with no staff session at all, plain sign-in", async () => {
    const p = await page("/audit", { "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 401, body: envelope("staff_session_required") } });
    const out = p.render();
    expect(out).toContain("Sign in with your staff key");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Your staff session ended");
  });

  test("only the sentence when the console is off", async () => {
    const p = await page("/", {});
    expect(p.render()).toBe(html(<Unavailable />));
  });

  test("the enrolment page with no session read", async () => {
    const token = "A".repeat(43);
    const p = await page(`/enroll/${token}`, {});
    expect(p.render()).toContain(">Register a security key</button>");
  });

  test("an address the console does not have", async () => {
    const p = await page("/nowhere", { "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: ME } });
    expect(p.render()).toMatch(/no page at this address/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { AuditEntry, AuditPage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { createStaffApi } from "../src/api";
import { readRecentSignIns, readSignInsAtOpening, serverNow, SIGN_IN_WINDOW_MS } from "../src/signins";
import { fakeFetch, makeMe } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * The home screen's list of every staff account's sign-ins in the last 7 days (3a design, section 9): the audit reader's
 * staff_sign_in filter, read page by page, newest first, until a sign-in older than 7 days.
 */
const NOW = Date.parse("2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z");
const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

let seq = 1000;
function signIn(ageMs: number, handle = "mod_anna"): AuditEntry {
  seq -= 1;
  return {
    seq,
    hash: "a".repeat(64),
    createdAt: new Date(NOW - ageMs).toISOString(),
    actorHandle: handle,
    action: "staff_sign_in",
    targetType: "staff_session",
    targetId: "2b7c1d3e-4f5a-4b6c-8d7e-9f0a1b2c3d4e",
    actionHash: null,
    keyId: null,
  };
}

describe("the staff sign-ins of the last 7 days", () => {
  test("the server's now, from the session's absolute end and the seconds left to it, not the browser's clock", () => {
    expect(serverNow(makeMe({ at: NOW, absolute: 3600 }))).toBe(NOW);
    expect(SIGN_IN_WINDOW_MS).toBe(7 * DAY);
  });

  test("reads pages until it meets a sign-in older than 7 days, and keeps none older", async () => {
    const pages: AuditPage[] = [
      { entries: [signIn(1000), signIn(DAY)], nextCursor: 51, copy: { lastPlace: null } },
      { entries: [signIn(3 * DAY), signIn(7 * DAY - 1)], nextCursor: 40, copy: { lastPlace: null } },
      { entries: [signIn(7 * DAY + 1, "old_one"), signIn(8 * DAY, "older")], nextCursor: 30, copy: { lastPlace: null } },
      { entries: [signIn(9 * DAY, "never_read")], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: null } },
    ];
    const asked: (number | undefined)[] = [];
    const list = await readRecentSignIns(async (cursor) => {
      asked.push(cursor);
      return pages[asked.length - 1]!;
    }, NOW - 7 * DAY);
    expect(asked).toEqual([undefined, 51, 40]);
    expect(list.map((e) => Date.parse(e.createdAt))).toEqual([NOW - 1000, NOW - DAY, NOW - 3 * DAY, NOW - 7 * DAY + 1]);
  });

  test("stops at the last page", async () => {
    const asked: (number | undefined)[] = [];
    const list = await readRecentSignIns(async (cursor) => {
      asked.push(cursor);
      return { entries: [signIn(DAY)], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: null } };
    }, NOW - 7 * DAY);
    expect(asked).toEqual([undefined]);
    expect(list).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("a cursor that does not move back stops the reading rather than loop", async () => {
    const asked: (number | undefined)[] = [];
    await readRecentSignIns(async (cursor) => {
      asked.push(cursor);
      return { entries: [signIn(DAY)], nextCursor: 51, copy: { lastPlace: null } };
    }, NOW - 7 * DAY);
    expect(asked).toEqual([undefined, 51]);
  });

  test("only sign-ins are listed, whatever else the answer holds", async () => {
    const other = { ...signIn(DAY), action: "staff_signed_out" };
    const list = await readRecentSignIns(async () => ({ entries: [other, signIn(DAY)], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: null } }), NOW - 7 * DAY);
    expect(list.map((e) => e.action)).toEqual(["staff_sign_in"]);
  });

  test("through the API: the filter on every page, each request marked as the person's opening of the screen", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      "GET /api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in": { status: 200, body: { entries: [signIn(DAY)], nextCursor: 12, copy: { lastPlace: null } } },
      "GET /api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in&cursor=12": { status: 200, body: { entries: [signIn(8 * DAY)], nextCursor: 3, copy: { lastPlace: null } } },
    });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    const list = await readRecentSignIns((cursor) => api.audit({ action: "staff_sign_in", cursor }, { activity: true }), NOW - 7 * DAY);
    expect(list).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fake.requests.map((r) => `${r.url} ${r.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`)).toEqual(["/api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in 1", "/api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in&cursor=12 1"]);
  });

  test("at the screen's opening: the server's time from a marked /me read then, and the pages back to 7 days before it", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: makeMe({ at: NOW, absolute: 3600 }) },
      "GET /api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in": { status: 200, body: { entries: [signIn(DAY), signIn(7 * DAY - 1000), signIn(7 * DAY + 1000)], nextCursor: 40, copy: { lastPlace: null } } },
    });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    const list = await readSignInsAtOpening(api);
    expect(list.map((e) => Date.parse(e.createdAt))).toEqual([NOW - DAY, NOW - 7 * DAY + 1000]);
    expect(fake.requests.map((r) => `${r.url} ${r.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`)).toEqual(["/api/staff/me 1", "/api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in 1"]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

/**
 * What the console's source must never hold (3a design, sections 3 and 9, and console-lab.md section 8). The page runs
 * under require-trusted-types-for 'script' with trusted-types 'none', so each of these sinks would throw at run time and
 * take its screen down; this scan finds them first. Every user-written string is a text node, and no link is built from
 * data.
 */
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const SRC = path.join(ROOT, "src");

/**
 * Every line of the page's source (src/, which the bundle is built from) matching `pattern`, as `file:line`. The build
 * and development scripts run in Node, never in the page, so they are not scanned: the page they write needs its one
 * script element.
 */
function findInSource(pattern: RegExp): string[] {
  const found: string[] = [];
  const files = readdirSync(SRC, { recursive: true, encoding: "utf8" }).map((file) => path.join("src", file));
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!/\.(ts|tsx|css)$/.test(file)) continue;
    const lines = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), "utf8").split("\n");
    lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      if (pattern.test(line)) found.push(`${file.split(path.sep).join("/")}:${index + 1}`);
    });
  }
  return found.sort();
}

describe("no HTML or script sink in apps/admin", () => {
  const sinks: [string, RegExp][] = [
    ["dangerouslySetInnerHTML", /dangerouslySetInnerHTML/],
    ["innerHTML and outerHTML", /\b(inner|outer)HTML\b/],
    ["insertAdjacentHTML", /insertAdjacentHTML/],
    ["createContextualFragment", /createContextualFragment/],
    ["document.write", /document\.write/],
    ["srcdoc", /srcdoc/i],
    ["eval", /\beval\s*\(/],
    ["new Function", /new\s+Function\b|\bFunction\s*\(/],
    ["a string as a timer's code", /setTimeout\(\s*["'`]|setInterval\(\s*["'`]/],
    ["a rendered script or style element", /<script|<style|createElement\(\s*["'`](script|style)/i],
    ["React's preinit and preload", /\bpre(init|initModule|load|loadModule)\b/],
    ["a style attribute set as text", /setAttribute\(\s*["'`]style/],
    ["setAttribute at all: React sets every attribute", /\.setAttribute\(/],
    ["a Trusted Types policy", /trustedTypes|createPolicy/],
    ["DOMParser", /DOMParser/],
    ["window.open and navigations built in code", /window\.open|location\.(href|assign|replace)\s*[=(]/],
  ];
  for (const [name, pattern] of sinks) {
    test(name, () => {
      expect(findInSource(pattern)).toEqual([]);
    });
  }

  test("no style prop: every style is in the one CSS file", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/\bstyle=\{/)).toEqual([]);
    const css = readdirSync(SRC, { recursive: true, encoding: "utf8" }).filter((file) => file.endsWith(".css"));
    expect(css).toEqual(["app.css"]);
  });

  test("no link is built from data: the only three hrefs written from a value are NavLink's, whose type lists the console's own paths, CaseLink's, built from a checked case id, and 3f's OrderLink's, built from a checked order id", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/href=\{/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/nav.tsx", "src/nav.tsx", "src/nav.tsx"]);
    const nav = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "nav.tsx"), "utf8");
    expect([...nav.matchAll(/href=\{[^}]*\}/g)].map((found) => found[0])).toEqual(["href={to}", "href={caseHref(id)}", "href={orderHref(id)}"]);
    expect(nav).toMatch(/id: OrderId/);
    expect(nav).toMatch(/to: ConsolePath/);
    expect(nav).toMatch(/id: CaseId/);
    const router = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "router.ts"), "utf8");
    expect(router).toContain('export type ConsolePath = "/" | "/audit" | "/signin" | "/queue" | "/appeals" | "/standing" | "/contact" | "/orders" | "/restore";');
    // An OrderId is made in one place too.
    expect(findInSource(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]as OrderId[^A-Za-z0-9_]/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/router.ts"]);
    // A CaseId is made in one place, by the function that checks it: nothing else may call a text a case's id.
    expect(findInSource(/\bas CaseId\b/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/router.ts"]);
    expect(router).toMatch(/return isLowerUuid\(text\) \? \(text as CaseId\) : null;/);
  });

  test("no src or action attribute written from a value, but the one image site, whose address is built from two checked ids and a literal size", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/\b(action|formAction|xlinkHref)=\{/)).toEqual([]);
    expect(findInSource(/\bsrc=\{/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/media.tsx"]);
    const media = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "media.tsx"), "utf8");
    expect(media).toMatch(/src=\{staffImageSrc\(caseId, mediaId, size\)\}/);
    expect(media).toMatch(/staffImageSrc\(caseId: CaseId, mediaId: ImageId, size: StaffImageSize\)/);
    expect(findInSource(/\bas ImageId\b/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/media.tsx"]);
    // An image element is written nowhere else.
    expect(findInSource(/<img\b/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/media.tsx"]);
    // And nothing else builds an image's address: staffImageSrc is declared and called in that file alone, once each.
    expect(findInSource(/\bstaffImageSrc\b/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/media.tsx", "src/media.tsx"]);
    expect(media.match(/\bstaffImageSrc\(/g)).toHaveLength(2);
    // A failed load reaches the page through a handler React attaches (a prop), never through an attribute written as text.
    expect(media).toMatch(/onError=\{onError\}/);
    expect(findInSource(/\bon[A-Z][A-Za-z]*=["'`]/)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("every refusal and every outcome is worded from messages.ts, one table each: no screen keeps a table of its own", () => {
    // A table of words by code or by outcome is an object whose keys are the contracts' names: none is written outside
    // the one file, where a second copy could drift from the first. A key opens a line or follows a brace or a comma.
    const keyed = /(^|[{,])\s*(rate_limited|not_found|invalid_request|staff_recused|text_invalid|restricted_rule|restricted_legal|no_violation|not_evident|not_available|partly_reversed|interim|correction)\s*:/;
    expect([...new Set(findInSource(keyed).map((found) => found.split(":")[0]))]).toEqual(["src/messages.ts"]);
    const messages = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "messages.ts"), "utf8").split("\n");
    for (const table of ["CASE_WORDS", "REVEAL_WORDS", "NOTE_WORDS", "FINDING_WORDS", "OUTCOME_WORDS", "DECISION_KINDS", "DECISION_OUTCOMES", "PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS", "COMPOSER_KINDS", "COMPOSER_OUTCOMES", "COMPOSER_WORDS"]) {
      expect(messages.filter((line) => line.startsWith(`export const ${table}:`) || line.startsWith(`export const ${table} =`)), table).toHaveLength(1);
      // Declared nowhere else: the name follows `const` in that one file only.
      expect(findInSource(new RegExp(`const ${table}[^A-Za-z0-9_]`)).map((found) => found.split(":")[0]), table).toEqual(["src/messages.ts"]);
    }
  });

  test("no link into the app: no source line writes the address of a post or a profile", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/["'`]\/(post|u)\//)).toEqual([]);
    expect(findInSource(/APP_ORIGIN|appOrigin/)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("never a passkey_* code or text: the console has its own words", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/passkey_/)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("the key is asked only after the console checked what it is asked to sign", () => {
  test("a confirmation asks the key in one function, which every confirmed action goes through", () => {
    const stepUp = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "step-up.ts"), "utf8");
    expect(stepUp.match(/credentials\.get\(/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stepUp).toMatch(/export async function confirmWithKey</);
    // The revocation of a session, the reveal, the decision and the review are callers of it; none asks the key itself.
    // 3f: and an order's event, an admin's correction of an order, and giving effect to an order (Task 3); Task 6: the
    // audit log's download and a gap closed as not needed.
    expect(stepUp.split("confirmWithKey(deps, action,").length - 1).toBe(9);
  });

  test("navigator.credentials is called only by the three ceremonies, each of which checks its challenge first", () => {
    // A fourth call site would need a check of its own (3a design, section 9): this list makes adding one a decision.
    expect(findInSource(/credentials\.(get|create)\(/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/enroll.ts", "src/sign-in.ts", "src/step-up.ts"]);
    const checks: [string, RegExp][] = [
      ["enroll.ts", /checkRegisterChallenge\(/],
      ["sign-in.ts", /checkSignInChallenge\(/],
      ["step-up.ts", /checkStepUpOptions\(/],
    ];
    for (const [file, check] of checks) {
      const source = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, file), "utf8");
      const call = source.search(/credentials\.(get|create)\(/);
      // The check is called in the function that makes the call, before it, as it runs before it. Only that function's
      // text up to the call is searched: a check declared in the same file (step-up.ts declares checkStepUpOptions) is
      // another top-level function, so its name there never stands in for the call.
      const declarations = [...source.matchAll(/^(export )?(async )?function \w+/gm)].map((found) => found.index ?? -1);
      const enclosing = Math.max(...declarations.filter((at) => at < call));
      expect(call, file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(enclosing, file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(source.slice(enclosing, call).search(check), file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    }
  });
});

describe("zod is jitless before the first schema is built", () => {
  test("the entry's first import is the module that sets it", () => {
    const main = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "main.tsx"), "utf8");
    const imports = [...main.matchAll(/^import\s.*$/gm)].map((m) => m[0]);
    expect(imports[0]).toBe('import "./zod-jitless";');
    expect(readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "zod-jitless.ts"), "utf8")).toMatch(/z\.config\(\{ jitless: true \}\);/);
  });

  test("the module imports nothing that builds a schema", () => {
    const source = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "zod-jitless.ts"), "utf8");
    expect([...source.matchAll(/^import\s.*$/gm)].map((m) => m[0])).toEqual(['import { z } from "zod";']);
  });

  test("loading it turns zod's eval probe off", async () => {
    await import("../src/zod-jitless");
    expect(z.config().jitless).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KINDS, ORDER_RULES, renderAlert, type AlertFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { StaffMessage } from "../../src/auth";
import { alertTick, channelHealth, staffAlert } from "../../src/moderation/alerts";
import { overview } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { ageMessageForTest, closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, nextValidity, outboxOf, outboxSince, removeMessages, type OutboxRow } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { newStaffKey, newStaffSession, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;

/**
 * The alert channel's time-driven alerts and its two legs (3f design, sections 6.1, 7.2 and 12.1; invariants 14 and 15):
 * alert_steps() writes an escalation at escalate_minutes and the deadline's two reminders, each once, and stops them when
 * the message is handled; a person already at work in the console is not absent; the daily test is written once a day.
 * The alert tick mails every row whose mail is its sentence once, never one of 3c's or 3e's kinds, and with NOTIFY on
 * judges the channel's health with its own alarms, once in 24 hours. staffAlert writes the row of every kind of 3c and
 * 3e and marks it mailed either way.
 *
 * The steps run inside transactions of the migrator that end in a rollback: there the test sets the times it needs and
 * pushes every staff session back a day, so that the sessions earlier files of the run opened do not count as someone at
 * work. The tick commits, as the server's does; its rows and messages are removed by id, and the file's last test holds
 * it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the alert steps and the alert tick", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staffEmail: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
    // A live staff account with a key and a session: the address the staff mails of this file go to, and a session a
    // test can mark as used.
    const staff = await newStaffKey(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    staffEmail = staff.user.email;
    await newStaffSession(w.authDb, staff.user.id, staff.key.id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  }, 60_000);
  afterEach(async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A message inside the migrator's transaction, received `minutes` ago: the migrator keeps the time it supplies. */
  const messageIn = async (tx: DbTx, minutes: number, extra: { stale?: boolean } = {}) => {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at, seen_at, stale)
      values ('inbox', ${nextValidity()}, 1, now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), ${extra.stale ?? false}) returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  };
  /** Every staff session pushed a day back, its lifetime with it: nobody is at work in the console. */
  const nobodyAtWork = (tx: DbTx) =>
    tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day', last_used_at = last_used_at - interval '1 day', idle_expires_at = idle_expires_at - interval '1 day', absolute_expires_at = absolute_expires_at - interval '1 day'`);
  const steps = async (tx: DbTx) => Number((await tx.execute<{ written: number }>(sql`select public.alert_steps() as written`))[0]!.written);
  const kinds = (rows: OutboxRow[]) => rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.step]);

  test("an unanswered message is escalated to every phone once, escalate_minutes after it arrived, and not before", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes - 1);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(kinds((await outboxOf(tx, early)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated"))).toEqual([]);
      const escalated = (await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated");
      expect(kinds(escalated)).toEqual([["contact_mail_escalated", 0]]);
      expect([escalated[0]!.priority, escalated[0]!.scope]).toEqual([5, "all"]);
      expect(Object.keys(escalated[0]!.facts).sort()).toEqual(["dueAt", "receivedAt"]);
      // Once a message: a second call writes nothing for it.
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toHaveLength(1);
    });
  });

  test("a person already signed in who acts in the console is not absent: a staff session created or used since the message arrived stops the escalation", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const [session] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from auth.staff_sessions limit 1`);
      expect(session, "a staff session of this run").toBeDefined();
      await tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set last_used_at = now() where id = ${session!.id}`);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_due for a message: one row at remind_minutes and one at the deadline, each once, with the deadline and the minutes left", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      const reminded = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = async (id: string) => (await outboxOf(tx, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due");
      expect(await due(early)).toEqual([]);
      const [first] = await due(reminded);
      expect([first!.step, first!.priority, first!.scope]).toEqual([0, 5, "all"]);
      expect(first!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      expect(renderAlert("order_due", first!.facts, new Date()).title).toBe(`${first!.facts.minutesLeft} minutes left`);
      // Past the deadline only the deadline's row: the later of the two that has passed.
      expect((await due(late)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([[0, 0]]);
      // Each once: a second call writes nothing; the deadline's row comes when the deadline passes.
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await due(reminded)).toHaveLength(1);
      await ageMessageForTest(tx, reminded, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await due(reminded)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([
        [0, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1],
        [1, 0],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("handling a message ends its steps, and a stale message never has any", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const handled = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral', handled_at = now() where id = ${handled}::uuid`);
      const stale = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { stale: true });
      await steps(tx);
      // The handled message keeps the first push its insert wrote, and gets nothing more.
      expect(kinds(await outboxOf(tx, handled))).toEqual([["contact_mail", 0]]);
      expect(await outboxOf(tx, stale)).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("the daily test is written once in 24 hours, pushed only", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
      await steps(tx);
      const [test] = await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at);
      expect([test!.priority, test!.scope, test!.step, Object.keys(test!.facts)]).toEqual([3, "all", 0, ["at"]]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_test.legs).toEqual(["push"]);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at)).toHaveLength(1);
      // A day later the next one, with the next step.
      // The transaction's own clock stands still: the row moves back a day and a minute.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await tx.execute<{ step: number }>(sql`select step from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test' order by step`)).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
    });
  });

  test("two calls at once write a step once: the unique key drops the second", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await ageMessageForTest(w.migrateDb, id, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
    await Promise.all([w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`), w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`)]);
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tick

  const tickDeps = (notify: "on" | "off") => ({ ...w.deps, config: { ...w.deps.config, NOTIFY: notify } });
  const mailsOf = (template: string) => w.mailer.to(staffEmail, template);

  test("the tick's mail leg mails a row whose mail is its sentence once, to every staff account, and marks it", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    const sent = mailsOf("contact_mail").length;
    const report = await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(report.channel).toBeNull();
    const [row] = await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id);

    // Mailed once: the next round finds nothing owed.

  test("a row whose mail no address took is tried again next round", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());

  test("staffAlert writes the row of each kind of 3c and 3e, with its counts and times, and marks it mailed whether or not an address took the mail; the tick never mails it again", async () => {

      { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 2, oldest: at },
      { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [{ lane: 1, count: 3, oldest: at }], interim: 0 },
      { template: "moderation_burst", handle: "mod_anna", count: 20 },
      { template: "moderation_reads", handle: "mod_anna", limit: 200 },

    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);

      w.mailer.mode = index % 2 === 0 ? "deliver" : "fail";
      try {
        expect(await staffAlert(w.deps, `alerts-steps-${randomUUID()}`, MIN, message), message.template).toBe("sent");
      } finally {

      }

      expect([row!.priority, row!.scope, row!.step, row!.mailed_at !== null], message.template).toEqual([ALERT_KINDS[message.template].priority, ALERT_KINDS[message.template].scope, null, true]);
      // The push names nobody: the handle of the staff mail is not among its facts.
      expect(JSON.stringify(row!.facts), message.template).not.toContain("mod_anna");
    }
    const mailed = messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length);
    await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length)).toEqual(mailed);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind like 'moderation_%' and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz`);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the channel's health

  const beat = (beatMinutesAgo: number | null, mailboxMinutesAgo: number | null) =>
    w.migrateDb.execute(sql`
      insert into public.notify_state (id, beat_at, mailbox_ok_at, push_ok_at)
      values (1, case when ${beatMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${beatMinutesAgo}::int) end,
                 case when ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int) end, now())
      on conflict (id) do update set beat_at = excluded.beat_at, mailbox_ok_at = excluded.mailbox_ok_at`);
  const alarms = (since: Date) => w.migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: AlertFacts; mailed: boolean }>(sql`select kind, facts, mailed_at is not null as mailed from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable') and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz order by id`);
  const clearAlarms = () => w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);

  test("with NOTIFY off the channel is off, its check is skipped, and the tick still writes and mails the steps", async () => {
    await beat(null, null);
    expect(await channelHealth(tickDeps("off"))).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
    const at = new Date();
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("off"))).raised).toEqual([]);
    expect(await alarms(at)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a beat older than channel_down_minutes is down: alert_channel_down once in 24 hours, mailed by the next round, and the home screen says so", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1, 0);
    const health = await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"));
    expect(health.channel).toBe("down");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual(["alert_channel_down"]);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual([]);
    const rows = await alarms(at);
    expect(rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["alert_channel_down", true]]);
    expect(Date.parse(String(rows[0]!.facts.since))).toBe(health.since!.getTime());
    expect(mailsOf("alert_channel_down").length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    // Mailed only: the watcher publishes no row of this kind.
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_channel_down.legs).toEqual(["mail"]);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("on"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.alerts.channel).toBe("down");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a push still owed for longer than channel_down_minutes reads as down, and a row past push_owed_minutes no longer counts", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(0, 0);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    // Every other row still owed is pushed meanwhile, as a working watcher would have: this file judges its own row.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where pushed_at is null and message_id is distinct from ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("down");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.pushOwedMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a fresh beat with a mailbox not read for channel_down_minutes is mailbox_unreachable, pushed and mailed, once in 24 hours", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(0, ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("mailbox");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual(["mailbox_unreachable"]);
    await alertTick(tickDeps("on"));
    expect((await alarms(at)).map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["mailbox_unreachable", true]]);
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.mailbox_unreachable.legs).toEqual(["push", "mail"]);
    await clearAlarms();
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  });

  test("the home screen counts the messages nobody handled, stale ones included, with the oldest and the earliest deadline", async () => {
    const first = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 60 * MIN));
    const second = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 2 * MIN));
    made.push(first, second);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("off"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.contact.open).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    const [stored] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ received_at: string }>(sql`select received_at from public.contact_messages where id = ${first}::uuid`);
    expect(home.contact.oldestAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(Date.parse(home.contact.oldestAt!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.parse(stored!.received_at));
    expect(Date.parse(home.contact.dueAt!)).toBe(Date.parse(home.contact.oldestAt!) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * MIN);
    expect(home.alerts).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3f, Task 2: an order's steps (section 6.1, the rows marked 0025)

  /** A removal order of the migrator's in the transaction, received `minutes` ago, with an item open or disabled. */
  async function orderIn(tx: DbTx, minutes: number, options: { disabled?: boolean; open?: boolean; kind?: string; verified?: boolean; reasons?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, received_at, opened_at, opened_via,
                                       verified_at, reasons)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${options.kind ?? "tco_removal"}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`S-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true,
              now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), 'cli',
              ${options.verified ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${options.reasons ? "the authority's reasons" : null})
      returning id`);
    if (options.open ?? true) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 1, 'https://elsewhere.example/open')`);
    if (options.disabled) {
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, added_at, disabled_at) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 2, 'https://elsewhere.example/done', now() - make_interval(hours => 2), now() - make_interval(mins => 1))`);
    }
    return row!.id;
  }
  const orderRows = async (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ kind: string; step: number; scope: string; priority: number; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select kind, step, scope, priority, facts from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by id`,
    )).map((r) => ({ ...r }));
  const restart = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string, annexMinutes: number, clarifiedMinutes: number) =>
    tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'manifest_error', now() - make_interval(mins => ${annexMinutes}), 'cli'),
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'clarification_received', null, now() - make_interval(mins => ${clarifiedMinutes}), 'cli')`);

  test("order_due for an order: at remind_minutes and at the deadline while an item is open, the clock runs and the order is not closed; never for one given effect in full, stopped or closed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const remind = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      const partial = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1, { disabled: true });
      const full = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { disabled: true, open: false });
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now() - make_interval(mins => 30), 'cli')`);
      const closed = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${closed}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = (rows: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof orderRows>>) => rows.filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due").map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.itemsOpen, r.scope, r.priority]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, late))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, late))[0]!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(0);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, partial))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      for (const none of [full, stopped, closed]) expect(due(await orderRows(tx, none))).toEqual([]);
      // The deadline passes for the order reminded at remind_minutes: the second reminder, once.
      // The order and its first reminder an hour further back, as the hour would have passed.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = received_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}), opened_at = opened_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where order_id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([
        [0, 1, "all", 5],
        [1, 1, "all", 5],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a restart of an order's clock rings the phone on call again, as a message's first push, once a restart; a second restart alerts again", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = await orderIn(tx, 50);
      await restart(tx, order, 40, 10);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const first = (await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail");
      expect(first.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "on_call", 5, ["dueAt"]]]);
      // The first restart's row was written when it came, nine minutes before the second.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => 9) where order_id = ${order}::uuid`);
      await restart(tx, order, 5, 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail").map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // A stopped clock does not ring.
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, 50);
      await restart(tx, stopped, 40, 10);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now(), 'cli')`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, stopped)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_unverified, daily: one count for orders given effect and not verified (or with an item added after the check), one for missing reasons, one for holds without an end", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'order_unverified'`);
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: true });
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: true, verified: true, reasons: true });
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: false });
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "order_unverified", since);
      // The verified order's disabled item was added two hours before its check: it counts as verified.
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, r.facts.textsMissing, r.facts.holdsOpen, typeof r.facts.oldestAt])).toEqual([[0, "all", 5, 1, 1, 0, "string"]]);
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 5: report_owed, daily, while a notification record is owed and was opened more than reportAlertHours ago, with how many and the oldest; none once it is sent", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      // Inside a transaction that ends in a rollback: no other file's owed record may count here.
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'report_owed'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.authority_notifications`);
      const record = async (hoursAgo: number) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at)
          values ('owed', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), now() - make_interval(hours => ${hoursAgo}), 'cli', now()) returning id`);
        return row!.id;
      };
      await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours - 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", since)).toEqual([]);
      const late = await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours + 2);
      await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", since);
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, typeof r.facts.oldestAt])).toEqual([[0, "all", 5, 2, "string"]]);
      // Sent, and the day over: nothing more.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'declined', declined_reason = 'not identifiable', closed_at = now() where id <> ${late}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'declined', declined_reason = 'a check that ended in no', closed_at = now() where id = ${late}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'report_owed'`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", new Date(since.getTime() - 2 * 24 * 60 * MIN))).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.report_owed.legs).toEqual(["push", "mail"]);
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 5: handover_undestroyed, daily, while a production with files was delivered more than handoverAlertDays ago and is not destroyed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'handover_undestroyed'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.productions`);
      const production = async (daysAgo: number, destroyed = false) =>
        tx.execute(sql`
          insert into public.productions (instrument, produced, files, archive_sha256, delivered_at, destroyed_at, destroyed_how, opened_at)
          values ('demand', '{files}', '[{"name": "files/ab/x/small.webp", "bytes": 1, "sha256": null}]'::jsonb, ${"a".repeat(64)},
                  now() - make_interval(days => ${daysAgo}), ${destroyed ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${destroyed ? "deleted" : null}, now())`);
      await production(ORDER_RULES.handoverAlertDays - 1);
      await production(ORDER_RULES.handoverAlertDays + 3, true);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "handover_undestroyed", since)).toEqual([]);
      await production(ORDER_RULES.handoverAlertDays + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "handover_undestroyed", since);
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "all", 3, 1, ["count"]]]);
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 6: copy_overdue, daily, from alert_steps() alone, while the newest copy mark is older than copyOverdueHours, or there is none and the audit log's first row is that old; a fresh mark ends it", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'copy_overdue'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.copy_marks`);
      const hours = ORDER_RULES.copyOverdueHours;
      // Every row of the record younger than the period, and no mark: nothing is overdue yet.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours - 1}::int) where chain_seq = (select min(chain_seq) from public.audit_log)`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "copy_overdue", since)).toEqual([]);
      // The first row is older than the period, and nobody ever took a copy.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set created_at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours + 5}::int) where chain_seq = (select min(chain_seq) from public.audit_log)`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "copy_overdue", since);
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.hours, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "all", 3, hours + 5, ["hours"]]]);
      // A fresh mark: the next day writes nothing; a mark older than the period writes the next step.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'copy_overdue'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (gen_random_uuid(), 1)`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxSince(tx, "copy_overdue", new Date(since.getTime() - 2 * 24 * 60 * MIN))).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0]);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.copy_marks set at = now() - make_interval(hours => ${hours + 1}::int)`);
      await steps(tx);
      const next = await outboxSince(tx, "copy_overdue", new Date(since.getTime() - 2 * 24 * 60 * MIN));
      expect(next.map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.hours])).toEqual([
        [0, hours + 5],
        [1, hours + 1],
      ]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.copy_overdue.legs).toEqual(["push", "mail"]);
    });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    // The tick's own daily test, which no message names, and the rows of this file's kinds of 3f.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where created_at >= ${started.toISOString()}::timestamptz and kind in ('alert_test', 'alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { NOT_HELD_KINDS, RECORDS_NOT_HELD, RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { recordDigest } from "../../src/cli/records";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { STAFF_USAGE, runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { newUserWithDevice } from "./auth-fixtures";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";

import { ORDER_TABLES, orderForTest, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const NEWLINE = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * The commands of the records to authorities (3f design, sections 7.13, 7.14, 8.11 and 10.5; W.8): each as the migrator,
 * one transaction with the 10-second lock timeout, the account's hold row before the record where a command releases
 * it, and its audit row last under the system actor (notification_recorded, production_recorded, address_checked),
 * whose later steps hold only the digest of the record's row. records lists and, with --verify, recomputes those digests;
 * notification-facts (in place of 3c's account-facts) prints the account's facts and records a production; a production
 * for an order to provide information waits for its tell rule; the hand-over's list holds one seal's files and its record
 * takes exactly those names. A refusal is one sentence ending in "nothing changed", exit 1, and writes nothing. The seal
 * commits with a real key; the last test removes what the file made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the commands of the records to authorities", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let recordsBefore: Record<string, number>;
  /** The sealed account: a real auth row with an address, a profile, a post with two images, sealed for good. */
  let account: { id: string; email: string; handle: string };

  const orders: string[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {

    const config = loadConfig();

    recordsBefore = await recordCounts(migrateDb);
    const { user } = await newUserWithDevice(createAuthRepo(authDb));
    const handle = `r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${user.id}::uuid, ${handle}, 'Sealed')`);
    account = { id: user.id, email: user.email, handle };
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 2, account.id);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    const [action] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${outcome.decisionId}::uuid and kind::text = 'seal_media'`);
    sealed = { postId: p.postId, caseId, sealActionId: action!.id, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {

  const env = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], input?: string) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input ?? "", "utf8"));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };

  const lastAudit = async (id: string) =>

      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${id} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
```
