    expect((await cli(["handover-record", id, "--channel", "courier", "--receipt", "R-1"], digests(listOrder))).code).toBe(1);

    const seized = await cli(["handover-list", sealed.sealActionId, "--instrument", "seizure", "--authority", "Staatsanwaltschaft", "--reference", "AZ 9"]);

    expect((await cli(["handover-record", seizure, "--taken"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect(await production(seizure)).toMatchObject({ instrument: "seizure", archive_sha256: null, destroyed_how: "taken by the authority" });

    // Refused: not a seal's row, and an instrument that does not hand files over.
    expect((await cli(["handover-list", randomUUID(), "--instrument", "demand", "--authority", "x", "--reference", "y"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["handover-list", sealed.sealActionId, "--instrument", "dsa_art10", "--authority", "x", "--reference", "y"])).code).toBe(1);
  });

  test("3f Task 6: after a restore a record is entered again with --gap, which closes that open gap of the class record as imported in the command's own transaction; any other gap is refused with nothing written", async () => {
    const gapOf = async (cls: string, closed = false) =>
      (
        await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, disposition)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 5, repeat('b', 64), 'notification_recorded', 'notification', gen_random_uuid()::text, now(), now(), ${cls}, ${closed ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${closed ? "imported" : null})
          returning id`)
      )[0]!.id;
    const record = await gapOf("record");
    const restriction = await gapOf("restriction");
    const closed = await gapOf("record", true);
    const p = await imagePost(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, 0, account.id);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    const { caseId } = await report(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "illegal");
    const owed = async () => (await recordsOf(migrateDb, account.id)).filter((r) => r.case_id === caseId).length;
    for (const gap of [restriction, closed, randomUUID()]) {
      expect((await cli(["notification-open", "--case", caseId, "--duty", "voluntary", "--gap", gap])).text).toBe(`err notification-open: gap ${gap} is not an open gap of the class record; nothing changed`);
    }
    expect((await cli(["notification-open", "--case", caseId, "--duty", "voluntary", "--gap", "nonsense"])).text).toBe("err notification-open: gap nonsense is not an open gap of the class record; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["records", "--gap", record])).text).toBe("err records: takes no --gap: it enters no record; nothing changed");
    expect(await owed()).toBe(0);
    const entered = await cli(["notification-open", "--case", caseId, "--duty", "voluntary", "--gap", record]);
    expect(entered.code).toBe(0);
    expect(entered.lines.at(-1)).toBe(`out notification-open: gap ${record} is closed: the record is entered again.`);
    expect(await owed()).toBe(1);
    const gaps = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; disposition: string | null }>(sql`select id, disposition from public.restore_gaps where id = any(${`{${record},${restriction}}`}::uuid[]) order by disposition nulls last`);
    expect(gaps.map((g) => [g.id, g.disposition])).toEqual([
      [record, "imported"],
      [restriction, null],
    ]);
    // A refusal of the command itself leaves the gap open: the transaction that would have closed it is rolled back.
    const another = await gapOf("record");
    expect((await cli(["notification-open", "--case", randomUUID(), "--duty", "voluntary", "--gap", another])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ open: boolean }>(sql`select closed_at is null as open from public.restore_gaps where id = ${another}::uuid`))[0]!.open).toBe(true);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where id = any(${`{${record},${restriction},${closed},${another}}`}::uuid[])`);
  });

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { STANDING_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { authorityHoldsFor } from "../../src/cli/records";
import { accessRequest, changeLink, setLimits, textVerify, type TextProblem } from "../../src/cli/staff-cases";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { ACCESS_WORDS, uuidBefore, type AccountAccessDraft, type ContactsAccessDraft } from "../../src/moderation";
import { newUserWithDevice } from "./auth-fixtures";

import { ageCase, authAccount, one } from "./retention-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { newStaffAccount, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Each test runs dozens of statements inside one open transaction, and text-verify reads whole tables.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

const ORIGIN = "https://korbat.example";

/**
 * The staff command line's commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13), against the real database: link,
 * unlink and the count that keys prints; limits; text-verify; and access-request (3f: account-facts is gone, replaced by
 * notification-facts, which cli-records.test.ts holds; access-request marks a case an authority asked to keep from the
 * person). What a command commits is taken back by the command itself (a link by unlink); everything else runs as the
 * migrator in a transaction that is rolled back, with its audit row. The suites share one database, in which earlier suites left audit rows of decisions
 * they removed again: text-verify reports those, rightly, so each test here looks at the problems about its own rows.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: staff.js link, unlink, limits, text-verify and access-request", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let beforeAuth: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
    beforeAuth = await authCaseCounts(migrateDb);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
    rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code, for a run that sees `env` alone. */
  async function cli(args: string[], env: Record<string, string>) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) });
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join("\n") };
  }
  const migrateEnv = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! });
  const keysEnv = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, DATABASE_URL_AUTH: process.env.DATABASE_URL_AUTH! });
  /** The audit rows of an action about a target, newest last, as the migrator reads them inside the test's transaction. */
  const auditRows = (q: Db | DbTx, action: string, targetId: string | null) =>
    q.execute<{ actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown>; step_up: unknown }>(
      sql`select actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata, step_up from audit_log where action = ${action} and target_id is not distinct from ${targetId} order by chain_seq`,
    );

  describe("link, unlink and keys", () => {
    test("link records a personal account for a staff account, keys prints how many and never which, and unlink takes it back; each writes one audit row that names only the staff account", async () => {
      const staff = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, "moderator");
      const staffHandle = `st_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
      await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: staff.user.id, handle: staffHandle, displayName: "Staff" });
      const personal = await newUserWithDevice(repo);
      const handle = `p_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
      await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: personal.user.id, handle, displayName: "Personal" });
      try {
        const linked = await cli(["link", staff.user.email.toUpperCase(), `@${handle.toUpperCase()}`], migrateEnv());
        expect(linked.code, linked.text).toBe(0);
        expect(linked.lines).toEqual([`out link: @${handle} is linked to ${staff.user.email}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`]);
        expect(await one(migrateDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from auth.staff_personal_accounts where staff_user_id = ${staff.user.id}::uuid and personal_user_id = ${personal.user.id}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
        // The audit row: the server's own, about the staff account, and nothing of the link.
        const added = await auditRows(migrateDb, "staff_link_added", staff.user.id);
        expect(added.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: "user", target_id: staff.user.id, metadata: {}, step_up: null }]);
        expect(JSON.stringify(added)).not.toContain(personal.user.id);

        // A second link of the same account changes nothing and says so.
        const again = await cli(["link", staff.user.email, handle], migrateEnv());
        expect(again.code).toBe(1);
        expect(again.lines).toEqual([`err link: @${handle} is already linked to ${staff.user.email}; nothing changed`]);
        expect((await auditRows(migrateDb, "staff_link_added", staff.user.id)).length).toBe(1);

        // keys: the count, on the auth role, and neither the handle nor the id of the linked account.
        const keys = await cli(["keys", staff.user.email], keysEnv());
        expect(keys.code, keys.text).toBe(0);
        expect(keys.lines).toEqual([`out moderator ${staff.user.email} @${staffHandle} (account ${staff.user.id})`, "out   no staff keys", "out   linked personal accounts: 1"]);
        expect(keys.text).not.toContain(handle);
        expect(keys.text).not.toContain(personal.user.id);
        // The auth role is told the count through the one function, and reads nothing of the table itself.
        const counted = await authDb.execute<{ staff_user_id: string; links: number }>(sql`select staff_user_id, links from auth.staff_link_counts() where staff_user_id = ${staff.user.id}::uuid`);
        expect(counted.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ staff_user_id: staff.user.id, links: 1 }]);
        expect((await authDb.execute(sql`select 1 from auth.staff_personal_accounts`).catch((err: unknown) => String((err as { cause?: unknown }).cause ?? err))).toString()).toMatch(/permission denied/);
      } finally {
        const unlinked = await cli(["unlink", staff.user.email, handle], migrateEnv());
        expect(unlinked.code, unlinked.text).toBe(0);
        expect(unlinked.lines).toEqual([`out unlink: @${handle} is no longer linked to ${staff.user.email}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`]);
      }
      expect((await auditRows(migrateDb, "staff_link_removed", staff.user.id)).map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: "user", target_id: staff.user.id, metadata: {}, step_up: null }]);
      const gone = await cli(["unlink", staff.user.email, handle], migrateEnv());
      expect(gone.code).toBe(1);
      expect(gone.lines).toEqual([`err unlink: @${handle} is not linked to ${staff.user.email}; nothing changed`]);
      const none = await cli(["keys", staff.user.email], keysEnv());
      expect(none.lines.at(-1)).toBe("out   linked personal accounts: 0");
    });

    test("link refuses an account that is not staff, a personal account that is staff, deleted or unknown, and the staff account itself, and writes nothing", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const staff = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const other = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const user = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const deleted = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        await authAccount(tx, staff.id);
        await authAccount(tx, other.id);
        await authAccount(tx, user.id);
        await authAccount(tx, deleted.id, "1 day");
        const email = (id: string) => `retention-${id}@korbat.local`;
        const links = async () => (await one<{ n: number }>(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from auth.staff_personal_accounts where staff_user_id in (${staff.id}::uuid, ${other.id}::uuid)`)).n;

        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), user.handle, false)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: `${email(staff.id)} is not staff (its role is user)` });
        await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id in (${staff.id}::uuid, ${other.id}::uuid)`);
        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), other.handle, false)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: `@${other.handle} is a staff account (its role is moderator); only a personal account is linked` });
        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), deleted.handle, false)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: `@${deleted.handle} is not a live account` });
        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), "nobody_has_this", false)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "no account has the handle @nobody_has_this" });
        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), staff.handle, false)).toMatchObject({ ok: false });
        expect(await changeLink(tx, "nobody@korbat.local", user.handle, false)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "no live account for nobody@korbat.local" });
        expect(await links()).toBe(0);
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "staff_link_added", staff.id)).length).toBe(0);
        // The link that is allowed, and the recusal it is for: the staff account may not decide a case about its own personal account.
        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), `@${user.handle}`, false)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
        expect(await links()).toBe(1);
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0, user.id);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.staff_case_conflict(${staff.id}::uuid, ${caseId}::uuid, false) as conflict`)).toEqual({ conflict: true });
        expect(await changeLink(tx, email(staff.id), user.handle, true)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.staff_case_conflict(${staff.id}::uuid, ${caseId}::uuid, false) as conflict`)).toEqual({ conflict: false });
      });
    });
  });

  describe("limits", () => {
    test("it sets the five numbers with one audit row that carries them, changes nothing when they already are, and works on a database whose row is missing", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const wanted = { decisionsPerHour: 30, decisionsPerDay: 150, caseOpensPerDay: 200, findingsPerDay: 20, revealsPerDay: 5 };
        const row = () => one(tx, sql`select decisions_per_hour as h, decisions_per_day as d, case_opens_per_day as o, findings_per_day as f, reveals_per_day as r from moderation_limits where id = 1`);
        const set = await setLimits(tx, wanted);
        expect(set).toEqual({ ok: true, lines: ["limits: set to 30 decisions an hour, 150 decisions a day, 200 case opens a day, 20 findings a day, 5 reveals a day. Keep these numbers in your own records: a restore brings back the ones of its backup."] });
        expect(await row()).toEqual({ h: 30, d: 150, o: 200, f: 20, r: 5 });
        const written = await auditRows(tx, "moderation_limits_set", null);
        expect(written.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: null, metadata: wanted, step_up: null });
        const count = written.length;
        expect(await setLimits(tx, wanted)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "the limits already are 30 decisions an hour, 150 decisions a day, 200 case opens a day, 20 findings a day, 5 reveals a day; nothing changed" });
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "moderation_limits_set", null)).length).toBe(count);
        // One number differs: the row changes and a second audit row is written.
        expect(await setLimits(tx, { ...wanted, revealsPerDay: 6 })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
        expect(await row()).toMatchObject({ r: 6 });
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "moderation_limits_set", null)).length).toBe(count + 1);
        // The row gone, as the integration setup's truncate would leave it: the command inserts it.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from moderation_limits`);
        expect(await setLimits(tx, wanted)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
        expect(await row()).toEqual({ h: 30, d: 150, o: 200, f: 20, r: 5 });
      });
    });

    test("run with the numbers the row already holds, it exits 1 and says so", async () => {
      const run = await cli(["limits", "60", "300", "400", "50", "10"], migrateEnv());
      expect(run.code).toBe(1);
      expect(run.lines).toEqual(["err limits: the limits already are 60 decisions an hour, 300 decisions a day, 400 case opens a day, 50 findings a day, 10 reveals a day; nothing changed"]);
    });
  });

  describe("text-verify", () => {
    /** The problems text-verify reports about any of these ids, or at any of these places of the audit log. */
    const about = (problems: TextProblem[], ids: readonly string[]) => problems.filter((p) => ids.includes(p.id)).map((p) => `${p.about}: ${p.message}`);
    const placesOf = async (tx: DbTx, decisionIds: readonly string[]) =>
      [...(await tx.execute<{ place: string }>(sql`select chain_seq::text as place from audit_log where metadata ->> 'decisionId' = any(${`{${decisionIds.join(",")}}`}::text[])`))].map((row) => row.place);

    test("it finds nothing wrong with decisions, texts, snapshots, levels, states and seals as the triggers left them, erased ones included", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(removed.postId));
        const withheld = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const sealed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const suspect = await report(tx, anAccount(sealed.authorId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const cleared = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(cleared.postId));
        const noAction = await decideIn(tx, mod, third.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const decisions = [withheld, removal, seal, noAction];
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [...decisions, ...(await placesOf(tx, decisions)), removed.postId, sealed.postId, cleared.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, ...cleared.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];

        const report1 = await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
        expect(about(report1.problems, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(report1.decisions).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
        expect(report1.seals).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect(report1.images).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
        expect(report1.problemCount).toBe(report1.problems.length);
        expect(report1.ok).toBe(report1.problemCount === 0);

        // Retention at work is nothing to report: an erased snapshot and an erased text keep their rows and digests.
        await ageCase(tx, third.caseId, "3 days");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${third.caseId}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update staff_texts set text = null, salt = null, erased_at = now() where case_id = ${first.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null`);
        expect(about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a decision changed as the migrator, a measure removed, a text and a snapshot that are gone or altered, and a decision with no row or with a row and no decision", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "illegal");
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [removal]);
        const q = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q.postId));
        const kept = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [keptPlace] = await placesOf(tx, [kept]);
        const mine = [removal, kept, place!, keptPlace!, p.postId];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // The decision's rule and outcome rewritten: what the key confirmed is no longer what is stored.
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', through_seq = 0 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: category, throughSeq`]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = ${SPEECH}, through_seq = 1 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // Its measure taken out of the ledger: the decision no longer holds what its row lists, and the post's level no longer follows.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`, "post: its level is stored as removed, and the ledger of measures gives visible"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.moderation_apply(array[${p.postId}]::uuid[], true)`);
        // A text deleted, and a snapshot's content rewritten.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where digest = (select legal_reference_digest from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = 'another body' where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          "audit: its legalReferenceDigest names no saved text",
          "audit: the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest",
          `decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`,
        ]);
        // The other decision deleted outright, with what hangs on it: its row in the record now names nothing korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set answered_by = null, outcome = null where answered_by = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where decision_id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decisions where id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(keptPlace)))).toEqual([`decision: the audit row at place ${keptPlace} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 5: a decision that marked reports verifies with its marks, a mark taken out of the record or a row whose list was altered is reported, and a row signed before 3e reads its missing list as none", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const second = await intake(tx, ground.rule((await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId));
        const items = [first.recorded.items[0]!.id, second.items[0]!.id].sort();
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const q2 = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q2.postId));
        const plain = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [place, plainPlace] = [(await placesOf(tx, [marked]))[0]!, (await placesOf(tx, [plain]))[0]!];
        const mine = [marked, plain, place, plainPlace];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The params signed both marks; one taken out of the record as the migrator is a difference in `unfounded`.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
        // A row signed before 3e carries neither member: its missing list reads as no marks, its missing replaced as false.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' #- '{params,replaced}' where chain_seq = ${plainPlace}::bigint`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(plainPlace)))).toEqual([]);
        // And such a row beside a decision that holds a mark is reported: what was not signed is not what korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' where chain_seq = ${place}::bigint`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 7: a mark that korbat's own rules deleted is no difference: its report's day left the frame (the retention job's step) or its sender was forgotten (the account's purge); a mark deleted while korbat still knows its report and sender is", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const senders = [await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)];
        const reports = [];
        for (const sender of senders) reports.push(await intake(tx, ground.rule(sender.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId)));
        const items = reports.map((recorded) => recorded.items[0]!.id);
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, reports[0]!.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [marked]);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [marked, place!]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The first report's day leaves the frame: forget_report_counts deletes its mark, as the retention job does.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intakes set received_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where id = ${reports[0]!.intakeId}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update unfounded_marks set reported_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_report_counts()`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The second sender's account is deleted: its purge forgets who sent the report and deletes the mark with it.
        await authAccount(tx, senders[1]!.id, "0 seconds");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_reporter(${senders[1]!.id}::uuid)`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The third mark taken out by hand, while its report is in the frame and its sender known: that is a difference.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[2]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3f Task 6: it reports a gap closed as not needed without its confirmed audit row; an item whose disabling a restore lost is no difference while its gap names it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [gap] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, disposition)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 4, repeat('c', 64), 'case_decided', now(), now(), 'no_measure', now(), 'not_needed') returning id`);
        const [order] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_via)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'DE', 'Bundeskriminalamt', ${`T-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true, 'cli') returning id`);
        const [item] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, disabled_at, preserve_until) values (${order!.id}::uuid, 1, 'sha256:x', now(), now() + interval '6 months') returning id`);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [gap!.id, order!.id]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          `gap: it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it`,
          `order: item ${item!.id}: it is recorded as disabled, and no measure of an order decision names it`,
        ]);
        await tx.execute(sql`
          insert into restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, acted_at, imported_at, class)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 5, repeat('d', 64), 'order_effected', 'order_item', ${item!.id}, now(), now(), 'order_effect')`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`gap: it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it`]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a post whose level the migrator set by hand, an image whose state was set, and a seal in force one of whose listed posts has lost an image row", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(removed.postId));
        await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const sealed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(sealed.postId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [removed.postId, sealed.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A removed post made visible again by hand, around the one writer of the level.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'visible', state = 'visible' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its level is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives removed"]);
        // The level put right and only the state left: the two must agree unless the author deleted the post.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'removed' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its state is stored as visible, and its level is removed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A sealed image shown again by hand.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'visible' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["image: its state is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives sealed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'sealed' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        // A sealed image row destroyed, which only the owner of the database can do: the keep trigger switched off first.

      counter = options.counter ?? counter + 1;
      const response = soft.get({ credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge: request.challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter });
      const res = await browser.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", { json: { response }, headers: options.headers });
      return { res, response };
    }
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    const first = await signIn(b, { headers: { "user-agent": FIREFOX_LINUX } });
    expect(first.res.status, await first.res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return { user, device, handle, soft, keyId: enrolled.key.id, credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, b, token: b.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!, signIn, first };
  }

  /**
   * The key's answer to step-up options for revoking the staff session `handle`, asked for from `s`'s browser as the
   * console asks for them, or over a challenge of the test's own.
   */
  async function confirmation(s: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>, handle: string, options: { counter: number; challenge?: string }) {
    let challenge = options.challenge;
    if (challenge === undefined) {
      const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: revokeRequest(handle), headers: MARKED });
      expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
      challenge = StaffStepUpOptionsResponse.parse(await res.json()).options.challenge;
    }
    return s.soft.get({ credentialId: s.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: options.counter });
  }
  const revokeSession = (b: Browser, handle: string, stepUp?: AuthenticationResponseJSON) =>
    b.fetch(`/api/staff/sessions/${handle}`, { method: "DELETE", ...(stepUp ? { json: { stepUp } } : {}), headers: MARKED });

  describe("signing in", () => {
    test("sets both staff cookies, __Host-, Secure, Path=/, SameSite=Strict and 12 hours long, the session's HttpOnly; answers /me's body with no CORS header and no-store", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const res = s.first.res;
      const cookies = setCookies(res);
      expect([...cookies.keys()].sort()).toEqual([STAFF_COOKIE, STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE]);
      const session = cookies.get(STAFF_COOKIE)!;
      const csrf = cookies.get(STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE)!;
      expect(session).toMatch(/^__Host-korbat_staff=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43};/);
      expect(csrf).toMatch(/^__Host-korbat_staff_csrf=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43};/);
      for (const line of [session, csrf]) {
        for (const attribute of ["Max-Age=43200", "Path=/", "Secure", "SameSite=Strict"]) expect(line).toContain(attribute);
        expect(line).not.toContain("Domain=");
      }
      expect(session).toContain("HttpOnly");
      expect(csrf).not.toContain("HttpOnly");
      // No app cookie is set on the console.
      expect(res.headers.getSetCookie().some((line) => line.startsWith("__Host-korbat_session=") || line.startsWith("__Host-korbat_csrf="))).toBe(false);
      expect(accessControlHeaders(res)).toEqual([]);
      expect(res.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("no-store");

      const me = StaffSignInVerifyResponse.parse(await res.json());
      const row = await sessionRow(s.token);
      expect(me).toMatchObject({ handle: s.handle, role: "moderator", sessionHandle: row.handle, idleSecondsLeft: 900, absoluteSecondsLeft: 43_200 });
      // The coarse label of the browser that signed in, never its user agent, as the session list and the mail show it.
      expect(row.browser).toBe("Firefox on Linux");
      expect(mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === s.user.email).map((m) => [m.template, m.data.browser])).toEqual([
        ["staff_key_added", undefined],
        ["staff_session_started", "Firefox on Linux"],
      ]);
    });

    test("one answer before the signature: a spent challenge, one of another purpose, one with another binding and a bad signature are staff_key_invalid, never a passkey code, and a bad signature on a live key reads as an unknown key", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const b = consoleBrowser();
      const key = challengeKey(decodeKey(config.AUTH_HMAC_KEY));
      const fresh = async () => StaffSignInOptionsResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/options", { method: "POST" })).json()).options.challenge;
      const assert = (challenge: string, counter: number) =>
        s.soft.get({ credentialId: s.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter });
      const spentChallenge = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(s.first.response.response.clientDataJSON, "base64url").toString()).challenge as string;
      const stranger = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const unknown = stranger.create({ rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge: randomBytes(58).toString("base64url"), origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, userHandle: randomBytes(32), flags: DEVICE_BOUND });

      const cases: [string, AuthenticationResponseJSON][] = [
        ["a spent challenge", assert(spentChallenge, 20)],
        ["the app's sign-in challenge", assert(issueChallenge(key, "signin", clock.now()), 21)],
        ["a staff registration challenge", assert(issueChallenge(key, "staff_register", clock.now(), randomUUID()), 22)],
        ["a staff sign-in challenge with a binding", assert(issueChallenge(key, "staff_signin", clock.now(), randomUUID()), 23)],
        ["a bad signature on a live key", badSignature(assert(await fresh(), 24))],
        ["an unknown key", stranger.get({ credentialId: unknown.id, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge: await fresh(), origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: 1 })],
      ];
      const answers: Record<string, { status: number; code: string; message: string }> = {};
      for (const [label, response] of cases) {
        const res = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", { json: { response } });
        const { code, message } = await error(res);
        answers[label] = { status: res.status, code, message };
        expect([label, res.status, code]).toEqual([label, 401, "staff_key_invalid"]);
        expect(code, label).not.toMatch(/^passkey_/);
        expect(res.headers.getSetCookie(), label).toEqual([]);
      }
      expect(answers["a bad signature on a live key"]).toEqual(answers["an unknown key"]);
      expect((await migrateDb.select().from(staffSessions).where(eq(staffSessions.userId, s.user.id))).length).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  describe("the person's own reads", () => {
    test("/me with the seconds left, /sessions with every live session and this one marked, /keys with the live keys and never a public key; no answer sets a cookie", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const other = consoleBrowser();
      expect((await s.signIn(other)).res.status).toBe(200);
      // Another account's session is never listed, nor a key the account no longer holds.
      await staffBrowser();
      const red = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, s.soft, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, s.user.id, { expiresAt: new Date(clock.ms() + 30 * MINUTE) })).token, { name: "Red key" });
      const old = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, s.soft, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, s.user.id, { expiresAt: new Date(clock.ms() + 30 * MINUTE) })).token, { name: "Old key" });
      await authDb.update(staffKeys).set({ revokedAt: clock.now() }).where(eq(staffKeys.id, old.key.id));
      clock.advance(MINUTE);

      for (const headers of [{}, MARKED]) {
        const me = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me", { headers });
        expect(me.status).toBe(200);
        expect(me.headers.getSetCookie()).toEqual([]);
        const body = StaffMe.parse(await me.json());
        expect(body.sessionHandle).toBe((await sessionRow(s.token)).handle);
        expect(body.absoluteSecondsLeft).toBe(12 * 60 * 60 - 60);
      }

      const sessions = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/sessions");
      expect(sessions.headers.getSetCookie()).toEqual([]);
      const listed = StaffSessionsResponse.parse(await sessions.json()).sessions;
      const mine = await sessionRow(s.token);
      const theirs = await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!);
      expect(listed.map((x) => [x.handle, x.current, x.browser]).sort()).toEqual(
        [
          [mine.handle, true, "Firefox on Linux"],
          [theirs.handle, false, "Browser on unknown OS"],
        ].sort(),
      );
      // The other browser sees the same two, with its own marked.
      const fromOther = StaffSessionsResponse.parse(await (await other.fetch("/api/staff/sessions")).json()).sessions;
      expect(fromOther.find((x) => x.current)!.handle).toBe(theirs.handle);

      const keys = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/keys");
      const text = await keys.clone().text();
      expect(StaffKeysResponse.parse(await keys.json()).keys.map((k) => [k.id, k.name])).toEqual([
        [s.keyId, "Blue key"],
        [red.key.id, "Red key"],
      ]);
      // The key that signed in shows when it was last used; nothing of any key's credential leaves the server.
      const [blue] = await migrateDb.select().from(staffKeys).where(eq(staffKeys.id, s.keyId));
      expect(text).toContain(blue!.lastUsedAt!.toISOString());
      for (const secret of [blue!.publicKey, blue!.credentialId]) expect(text).not.toContain(secret);
    });
  });

  describe("the idle and absolute limits", () => {
    test("only marked requests count: unmarked reads neither slide the idle end nor move last_used_at, so the session ends 15 minutes after the last marked one", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const t0 = (await sessionRow(s.token)).createdAt.getTime();
      clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
      const unmarked = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me");
      expect(StaffMe.parse(await unmarked.json()).idleSecondsLeft).toBe(5 * 60);
      expect(await sessionRow(s.token)).toMatchObject({ lastUsedAt: new Date(t0), idleExpiresAt: new Date(t0 + 15 * MINUTE) });

      clock.advance(4 * MINUTE);
      const marked = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me", { headers: MARKED });
      expect(StaffMe.parse(await marked.json()).idleSecondsLeft).toBe(15 * 60);
      expect(await sessionRow(s.token)).toMatchObject({ lastUsedAt: new Date(t0 + 14 * MINUTE), idleExpiresAt: new Date(t0 + 29 * MINUTE) });

      // Any other value of the header marks nothing.
      clock.advance(MINUTE);
      expect((await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/sessions", { headers: { "x-staff-activity": "true" } })).status).toBe(200);
      clock.advance(13 * MINUTE);
      expect((await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/keys")).status).toBe(200);
      expect(await sessionRow(s.token)).toMatchObject({ lastUsedAt: new Date(t0 + 14 * MINUTE), idleExpiresAt: new Date(t0 + 29 * MINUTE) });

      // At the idle end, the next request is refused and the cookies cleared; a marked one revives nothing.
      clock.advance(MINUTE);
      await expectEnded(await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me"), "at the idle end");
      expect(s.b.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)).toBeUndefined();
      await expectEnded(await raw("/api/staff/me", { headers: { cookie: `${STAFF_COOKIE}=${s.token}`, ...MARKED } }), "marked, after the idle end");
      expect(await sessionRow(s.token)).toMatchObject({ lastUsedAt: new Date(t0 + 14 * MINUTE), idleExpiresAt: new Date(t0 + 29 * MINUTE), revokedAt: null });
    });

    test("a marked request slides the idle end, never past the absolute end, which ends the session after 12 hours whatever its person does", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const row = await sessionRow(s.token);
      const t0 = row.createdAt.getTime();
      expect(row.absoluteExpiresAt).toEqual(new Date(t0 + 12 * HOUR));
      // A marked request every 14 minutes for 11 hours and 54 minutes.
      for (let i = 0; i < 51; i++) {
        clock.advance(14 * MINUTE);
        expect((await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me", { headers: MARKED })).status, `request ${i}`).toBe(200);
      }
      expect(await sessionRow(s.token)).toMatchObject({ lastUsedAt: new Date(t0 + 714 * MINUTE), idleExpiresAt: new Date(t0 + 12 * HOUR) });
      const me = StaffMe.parse(await (await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me", { headers: MARKED })).json());
      expect([me.idleSecondsLeft, me.absoluteSecondsLeft]).toEqual([6 * 60, 6 * 60]);
      expect(me.idleExpiresAt).toBe(me.absoluteExpiresAt);
      clock.advance(6 * MINUTE);
      await expectEnded(await raw("/api/staff/me", { headers: { cookie: `${STAFF_COOKIE}=${s.token}` } }), "unmarked, at the absolute end");
      await expectEnded(await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me", { headers: MARKED }), "at the absolute end");
    });
  });

  describe("every way a session ends, refused at its next request", () => {
    type Ender = [string, (s: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>) => Promise<void>];
    const enders: Ender[] = [
      ["a revocation by the command line", async (s) => void (await revokeStaffKeys({ repo, mailer }, s.user.email, s.keyId))],
      ["a revocation of every key by the command line", async (s) => void (await revokeStaffKeys({ repo, mailer }, s.user.email, "all"))],
      [
        "a counter that went backwards in another browser",
        async (s) => {
          const { res } = await s.signIn(consoleBrowser(), { counter: 1 });
          expect((await error(res)).code).toBe("staff_key_suspended");
        },
      ],
      ["a demotion by grant-role", async (s) => void (await runGrantRole({ authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer }, s.user.email, "user"))],
      ["a change from moderator to admin", async (s) => void (await runGrantRole({ authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer }, s.user.email, "admin"))],
      ["the account's take-down", async (s) => void (await repo.takeDown(s.user.id, clock.now(), null))],
      // Changes that revoke nothing: the session is read with its key and its account at every request, so no tombstone is needed.
      ["its key revoked in the database alone", async (s) => void (await authDb.update(staffKeys).set({ revokedAt: clock.now() }).where(eq(staffKeys.id, s.keyId)))],
      ["the account's role set to user in the database alone", async (s) => void (await authDb.update(users).set({ role: "user" }).where(eq(users.id, s.user.id)))],
      ["the account marked deleted in the database alone", async (s) => void (await authDb.update(users).set({ deletedAt: clock.now() }).where(eq(users.id, s.user.id)))],
      ["the session revoked in the database", async (s) => void (await authDb.update(staffSessions).set({ revokedAt: clock.now() }).where(eq(staffSessions.id, sha256Hex(s.token))))],
      [
        "a revocation confirmed with the key in another browser",
        async (s) => {
          const other = consoleBrowser();
          expect((await s.signIn(other)).res.status).toBe(200);
          const handle = (await sessionRow(s.token)).handle;
          const stepUp = await confirmation({ ...s, b: other }, handle, { counter: 3 });
          expect((await revokeSession(other, handle, stepUp)).status).toBe(204);
        },
      ],
      [
        "a counter that went backwards at a step-up",
        async (s) => {
          const handle = (await sessionRow(s.token)).handle;
          const res = await revokeSession(s.b, handle, await confirmation(s, handle, { counter: 1 }));
          expect([res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([403, "staff_key_suspended"]);
        },
      ],
    ];
    for (const [label, end] of enders) {
      test(label, { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
        const s = await staffBrowser();
        expect((await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me")).status).toBe(200);
        await end(s);
        // Both of requireStaff's reads refuse it: the plain read (no mark, as the console's idle timer and 3c's refreshes
        // read) and the marked one, which slides the idle end in the same statement. Each is sent with the token by hand,
        // since the first 401 clears the browser's cookies; then the browser's own request.
        await expectEnded(await raw("/api/staff/me", { headers: { cookie: `${STAFF_COOKIE}=${s.token}` } }), `${label}, unmarked`);
        await expectEnded(await raw("/api/staff/me", { headers: { cookie: `${STAFF_COOKIE}=${s.token}`, ...MARKED } }), `${label}, marked`);
        await expectEnded(await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me", { headers: MARKED }), label);
        expect(s.b.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(s.b.cookie(STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE)).toBeUndefined();
      });
    }

    test("signing out: 204, both cookies cleared, the session revoked with staff_signed_out and its audit row, and no mail", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const row = await sessionRow(s.token);
      const sent = mailer.sent.length;
      const before = await head();
      clock.advance(MINUTE);
      const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/signout", { method: "POST" });
      expect(res.status).toBe(204);
      const cookies = setCookies(res);
      expect([...cookies.keys()].sort()).toEqual([STAFF_COOKIE, STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE]);
      for (const line of cookies.values()) expect(line).toContain("Max-Age=0");
      expect((await sessionRow(s.token)).revokedAt).toEqual(clock.now());

      const [event] = await migrateDb
        .select({ metadata: authEvents.metadata })
        .from(authEvents)
        .where(and(eq(authEvents.userId, s.user.id), eq(authEvents.type, "staff_signed_out")));
      expect(event!.metadata).toEqual({ handle: row.handle });
      const written = await migrateDb.select().from(auditLog).where(gt(auditLog.chainSeq, before.seq)).orderBy(asc(auditLog.chainSeq));
      expect(written.map((r) => [r.action, r.actorId, r.targetType, r.targetId, r.staffSession, r.keyId, r.requestId, r.metadata])).toEqual([
        ["staff_signed_out", s.user.id, "staff_session", row.handle, row.handle, s.keyId, res.headers.get("x-request-id"), {}],
      ]);
      expect(mailer.sent.length).toBe(sent);
      await expectEnded(await raw("/api/staff/me", { headers: { cookie: `${STAFF_COOKIE}=${s.token}` } }), "after signing out");
      // Signing out again is a session that has ended.
      await expectEnded(await raw("/api/staff/signout", { method: "POST", headers: { origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, cookie: `${STAFF_COOKIE}=${s.token}; ${STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE}=x`, "x-staff-csrf": "x" } }), "signing out twice");
    });
  });

  describe("revoking a session, confirmed with the staff key", () => {
    test("the options name the session's key alone over a challenge the console can check; DELETE with the confirmation answers 204, the session ends at its next request, and the row carries the request's id and the confirmation", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const other = consoleBrowser();
      expect((await s.signIn(other)).res.status).toBe(200);
      const mine = await sessionRow(s.token);
      const target = await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!);
      const request = revokeRequest(target.handle);

      const optionsRes = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: request, headers: MARKED });
      expect(optionsRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(accessControlHeaders(optionsRes)).toEqual([]);
      expect(optionsRes.headers.getSetCookie()).toEqual([]);
      const { options } = StaffStepUpOptionsResponse.parse(await optionsRes.json());
      expect(options.rpId).toBe(TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID);
      expect(options.allowCredentials).toEqual([{ id: s.credentialId, type: "public-key", transports: ["usb", "nfc"] }]);
      expect(options.userVerification).toBe("required");
      // What the console checks before it asks for the key: the layout, the purpose, and the binding of its own session's
      // handle and the hash of what it sent.
      const actionHash = await stepUpActionHash(request);
      const challenge = Buffer.from(options.challenge, "base64url");
      const L = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
      expect(challenge).toHaveLength(L.bytes);
      expect(challenge[L.purposeAt]).toBe(L.purpose);
      expect(challenge.subarray(L.bindingAt, L.sealAt).equals(Buffer.from(await stepUpBinding(mine.handle, actionHash)))).toBe(true);

      const stepUp = await confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 3, challenge: options.challenge });
      const before = await head();
      clock.advance(MINUTE);
      const res = await revokeSession(s.b, target.handle, stepUp);
      expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(204);
      expect(res.headers.getSetCookie()).toEqual([]);
      expect(accessControlHeaders(res)).toEqual([]);
      expect((await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!)).revokedAt).toEqual(clock.now());
      const written = await migrateDb.select().from(auditLog).where(gt(auditLog.chainSeq, before.seq)).orderBy(asc(auditLog.chainSeq));
      expect(written.map((r) => [r.action, r.actorId, r.targetType, r.targetId, r.staffSession, r.keyId, r.actionHash, r.stepUp, r.metadata, r.requestId])).toEqual([
        [
          "staff_session_revoked",
          s.user.id,
          "staff_session",
          target.handle,
          mine.handle,
          s.keyId,
          actionHash,
          { authenticatorData: stepUp.response.authenticatorData, clientDataJSON: stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, signature: stepUp.response.signature },
          { params: {} },
          res.headers.get("x-request-id"),
        ],
      ]);
      await expectEnded(await other.fetch("/api/staff/me"), "the revoked session");
      expect((await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me")).status).toBe(200);
      // The person may end the session they ask from as well; it ends at its next request.
      expect((await revokeSession(s.b, mine.handle, await confirmation(s, mine.handle, { counter: 4 }))).status).toBe(204);
      await expectEnded(await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/me"), "the session that revoked itself");
    });

    test("without a confirmation the answer is staff_step_up_required; a body, target or options request the schemas refuse is invalid_request; without the staff CSRF header, csrf_failed; nothing changes", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const other = consoleBrowser();
      expect((await s.signIn(other)).res.status).toBe(200);
      const target = await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!);
      const before = await head();
      for (const [label, init] of [
        ["no body", { method: "DELETE" }],
        ["an empty body", { method: "DELETE", json: {} }],
      ] as const) {
        const res = await s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/sessions/${target.handle}`, init);
        expect([label, res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([label, 403, "staff_step_up_required"]);
      }
      // Any assertion's shape will do for the schemas: the sign-in's is one.
      const shaped = s.first.response;
      for (const [label, path, body] of [
        ["a member the action's params do not take", `/api/staff/sessions/${target.handle}`, { all: true, stepUp: shaped }],
        ["a stepUp that is not an assertion", `/api/staff/sessions/${target.handle}`, { stepUp: { id: "x" } }],
        ["a handle that is not a uuid", "/api/staff/sessions/not-a-handle", { stepUp: shaped }],
      ] as const) {
        const res = await s.b.fetch(path, { method: "DELETE", json: body });
        expect([label, res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([label, 400, "invalid_request"]);
      }
      for (const [label, body] of [
        ["an action no step-up confirms", { ...revokeRequest(target.handle), action: "role_granted" }],
        ["another target type", { ...revokeRequest(target.handle), target: { type: "user", id: target.handle } }],
        ["params the action does not take", { ...revokeRequest(target.handle), params: { all: true } }],
        ["a target that is not a uuid", revokeRequest("not-a-handle")],
      ] as const) {
        const res = await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: body });
        expect([label, res.status, (await error(res)).code]).toEqual([label, 400, "invalid_request"]);
      }
      // A write without the staff CSRF header is refused before the session is read, the options included.
      const stepUp = await confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 3 });
      expect((await s.b.fetch(`/api/staff/sessions/${target.handle}`, { method: "DELETE", json: { stepUp }, csrf: false })).status).toBe(403);
      expect((await s.b.fetch("/api/staff/step-up/options", { json: revokeRequest(target.handle), csrf: false })).status).toBe(403);
      expect((await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!)).revokedAt).toBeNull();
      expect(await head()).toEqual(before);
      // The confirmation the refused write carried was never read, so it still confirms what it was given for.
      expect((await revokeSession(s.b, target.handle, stepUp)).status).toBe(204);
    });

    test("a spent challenge, one of another purpose, one with another binding and a bad signature are staff_step_up_invalid, never a passkey code; an expired one is challenge_expired", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await staffBrowser();
      const other = consoleBrowser();
      expect((await s.signIn(other)).res.status).toBe(200);
      const mine = await sessionRow(s.token);
      const target = await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!);
      const key = challengeKey(decodeKey(config.AUTH_HMAC_KEY));
      const actionHash = await stepUpActionHash(revokeRequest(target.handle));
      const fresh = await confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 3 });
      const freshChallenge = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(fresh.response.clientDataJSON, "base64url").toString()).challenge as string;
      const signInChallenge = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(s.first.response.response.clientDataJSON, "base64url").toString()).challenge as string;
      const cases: [string, () => Promise<AuthenticationResponseJSON>][] = [
        // The library refuses it, after the challenge was spent: the same challenge signed well is then a spent one.
        ["a bad signature", async () => badSignature(fresh)],
        ["a spent step-up challenge", () => confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 4, challenge: freshChallenge })],
        ["the sign-in's challenge", () => confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 5, challenge: signInChallenge })],
        ["a staff sign-in challenge", () => confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 6, challenge: issueChallenge(key, "staff_signin", clock.now()) })],
        ["a re-authentication challenge for this session", () => confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 7, challenge: issueChallenge(key, "reauth", clock.now(), mine.handle) })],
        ["a step-up challenge for another session", () => confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 8, challenge: issueStepUpChallenge(key, clock.now(), target.handle, actionHash) })],
        [
          "a step-up challenge for another target",
          async () => confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 9, challenge: issueStepUpChallenge(key, clock.now(), mine.handle, await stepUpActionHash(revokeRequest(mine.handle))) }),
        ],

        expect(code, label).not.toMatch(/^passkey_/);
      }
      const late = await confirmation(s, target.handle, { counter: 10 });
      clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
      const expired = await revokeSession(s.b, target.handle, late);
      expect([expired.status, (await error(expired)).code]).toEqual([400, "challenge_expired"]);
      expect((await sessionRow(other.cookie(STAFF_COOKIE)!)).revokedAt).toBeNull();
    });

    test("a session that ends inside the step-up is answered as requireStaff answers it, staff_session_required with both cookies cleared: its key revoked just before the options, or its key revoked or its account demoted between the confirmation and the action", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
